| | We're going to keep hammering this home, Team,**** because the mainstream media continues to ignore this executive order and how it will change our elections forever. President Donald Trump's massive anti-voting executive order has sent lawmakers, election officials, and voting rights advocates into a frenzy. One provision focuses on a goal that for years has been a borderline obsession for MAGA: Cracking down on voting by mail. **For background:** After every election in which he's been a candidate or in power, Trump has raged over the use of mail-in ballots in general and ballot deadlines in particular _._ He's tried to claim fraud for every single ballot counted after Election Day. So of course, this order directs Attorney General Pam Bondi to “take all necessary action” against any states that count absentee or mail-in ballots received after Election Day. This order makes it clear that the MAGA crew will do anything they can to codify their power permanently and silence the will of the people by suppressing and eliminating the votes we cast. [**We've got to keep fighting and work to protect our elections and our fundamental right to vote. clean_body: Democracy Docket: With New Order, Trump Tries to Kill Off Vote By Mail | | | Trump’s order is the culmination of years of attacks on absentee ballots and vote-by-mail. In the months before the 2020 election, Trump repeatedly spread disinformation and conspiracy theories about the legitimacy of mail-in ballots as he campaigned for reelection. Now that he's back in power he wants to end their use forever. | | | | | We're going to keep hammering this home, Team,** because the mainstream media continues to ignore this executive order and how it will change our elections forever. President Donald Trump's massive anti-voting executive order has sent lawmakers, election officials, and voting rights advocates into a frenzy. One provision focuses on a goal that for years has been a borderline obsession for MAGA: Cracking down on voting by mail. For background:** After every election in which he's been a candidate or in power, Trump has raged over the use of mail-in ballots in general and ballot deadlines in particular . He's tried to claim fraud for every single ballot counted after Election Day. So of course, this order directs Attorney General Pam Bondi to “take all necessary action” against any states that count absentee or mail-in ballots received after Election Day. This order makes it clear that the MAGA crew will do anything they can to codify their power permanently and silence the will of the people by suppressing and eliminating the votes we cast. If you've saved your payment information with FastAction, your donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | | | | | We all know that mail-in voting laws are about ballot accessibility, making it easier for voters to participate in our elections. Elderly voters, the disabled, our military service members -- they all vote by mail. Mail-in voting has happened dating back to the Civil War. It's always been safe and secure, mail-in voting fraud is supremely rare. States have spent millions of taxpayer dollars investigating voter fraud since 2020's "big lie" and found virtually nothing. It's been used widely in some states for decades and in most of the country since the pandemic. Our partners at VoteAmerica said it best: “ There is no good-faith reason to limit vote-by-mail access, reject ballots without postmarks, or refuse to count ballots that arrive after Election Day. If the administration moves forward with these proposals, they will effectively disenfranchise older voters, rural voters, and military voters. ” | | | | | | | ---|---|---|--- Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country. Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities. body:
| | Peter, I’ll be honest: fundraising has been slower than we’d hoped so far this year.

I know things are tough for so many people right now – while working families are worried about the safety of our streets and being able to afford eggs without reaching for the credit card, we’re being inundated with headlines about petty political fights and foreign billionaires dismantling our government.

It can feel overwhelming, but I’m here to reassure you that together, we can defend our shared values and deliver real solutions to the problems our communities face.

I’m working tirelessly to uphold that mission in Congress, but far-right extremists and national GOP donors are already doing everything they can to defeat me.

I’m counting on your help to lay the groundwork for another tough re-election fight. Can you help with a donation of any amount before our FEC deadline on Monday?

| Dear Peter:
This week in Judiciary committee, we debated a number of dangerous bills that will make us all less safe. They really are live wires.

Republicans claim that they are support law enforcement and yet they just passed a series of bills that would turn retired law enforcement officers into arms dealers, allow firearms in national parks, allow firearm holders from one state to enter another state governed by the gun laws of a less restrictive state, and for ironic measure, a bill to collect data on the mental health and well-being of law enforcement. You can't make up this madness.

So click below to see what I had to say.

---
| [ ](https://sydneykamlager.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7fbfb0a1bdf4e44789fab92d0&id=5f882129b0&e=e6ba7d1bc4)
---
Calling out the duplicity of the Republican talking points
|
They are making moves that are illegal, unethical, unsafe, unconstitutional and unwise. What they are doing is obscene, but I am done talking about them.

**I want to talk about us.**

I am focusing on the innovators, educators, artists, farmers, dreamers and hustlers - those who were born here or moved here - who stay here because they want a better opportunity. I meet them throughout my district and the country and **we** all want similar things.

_More jobs, opportunity, and fairness.
Diversity in thought, ingenuity and collaboration.
Greater access to affordability, security and attainability._

We deserve a government that supports our health, safety and economic wellbeing. Communities thrive when industries arrive. Industries get better when educated minds get involved. Societies prosper when families prosper. It is not rocket-science; it is connection.

The 'American Dream' is achievable as long as it includes a thriving government that protects its workers and serves its communities. We can get there as long as we fight for a system that is fundamentally fair and works with us in mind and not the billionaires.

That is what I am fighting for.

Of course, I will continue to inform you about what is happening and fight like hell **against** the Maga-ites who care more about making Trump happy than making this country whole, but I am also going to be sharing what I am fighting **FOR** because that is more critical, constructive and connective.

**They can keep the madness. We are reclaiming our future.**

---
|

Peter, in the last few weeks alone, Trump has dramatically ramped up his dictatorial instincts and abuse for the rule of law.

❌ He declared, without legal basis, that Joe Biden’s pardons were **“void and vacant”** & announced politically motivated investigations of Adam Schiff, Jamie Raskin, and other members of the January 6th committee.

❌ He ignored court orders from a federal judge and called on federal judges who disagree with him to be impeached.

❌ He once again hinted at running for a Constitutionally-barred 3rd term.

Peter, I want to be clear here. I have great faith in the American people to always be willing to counter authoritarianism and dictators, but our country has never before been tested like this. **Faith and hope are critical, but action is necessary.**

I’m fighting with my Democratic colleagues to flip critical special elections coming up in just a few days. If we take this step toward taking back the House, our path to stopping Trump’s authoritarianism becomes 10x easier.

**But we can’t flip the House blue without your support today, Peter.** [**I’m counting on you to take the necessary action today to fight for a Democratic Majority and stand up to Trump’s creeping authoritarianism. name: David Horowitz
subject: Who is the enemy within?
body:
America is on the brink of destruction.

| |
---
| | Fellow Patriot, America is on the brink of destruction. I don’t say this to shock or scare you – I say it because it’s true. _What we see today didn’t happen overnight. It’s the result of a movement that began with the Communist revolution in Russia and has been 100 years in the making..._ **...and Barack Obama hit the accelerator button, fast tracking their agenda.** I’d know better than most. When I was a young man, I was one of the leaders of the movement destroying America today. 50 years ago, I was a Marxist revolutionary bent on bringing America as we know it to an end. I stood side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited _Ramparts_ – radical Left's largest magazine. I marched, wrote manifestos, and attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam. My eyes opened to the incredible destruction and evil my “comrades” made possible. So I left and never looked back. I cast my 1984 ballot for Ronald Reagan – then I started the David Horowitz Freedom Center to fight the Left and I’ve dedicated the last 40 years to exposing them. Why? Because I knew first-hand the threat our country was facing. I knew what was at stake and I knew if I didn’t tell the American people what I knew, we would lose our country forever. That’s why I spent 6 months writing** _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_** – and I want you to have your very own copy of it. **[So I’m asking you to stand with me and make a generous, tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to my Freedom Center. As a thank you, I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z1skeifodhhlgb1315m1niq1akmfmrs3j1kftuh8_rp22sh2s8i6eob6cph61o75c5h2bs)** When you think of “the enemy within” you may think of Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi or even Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez...and you wouldn’t be wrong. But make no mistake: **The real mastermind is Barack Obama.** Barack Obama laid the groundwork for everything we’ve seen since 2020 back in 2008. Barack Obama led the destruction of our cities, cozying up to Black Lives Matter radicals and siding with criminals over police upholding the rule of law. Barack Obama championed the castration of our military, making us a laughingstock on the world stage. And Barack Obama was the true architect behind the bogus Russian collusion witch hunt. The devastation and destruction we see today has been over a decade in the making – but most of the American people have no clue what we’re up against. **That’s why I wrote _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_ to explain how communist and fascist Leftists infiltrated and overtook the Democrat Party...** ...how it has become a party of racism and hatred attacking the very foundations of our country... ... and how their ultimate goal is to create a one-party state – and cancel, deplatform and silence every last one of their political opponents by slandering them as “white supremacists” and worse. The reviews speak for themselves... “A Great Book” – Dinesh D’Souza “ _The Enemy Within_ is a book for all patriots who understand that our country is in a fight for its life.” – Mark Levin “David Horowitz does it again in a must-read for any American concerned about where we are headed as a nation.” Laura Ingraham I wrote _The Enemy Within_ because... I know if our country stands a chance, Americans must understand exactly how sinister and dangerous the new Democrat Party actually is. I was the enemy within — and I know in my bones what it will take to defeat them. We’ve reached the point in our history that will decide our future – and we either win these political battles or lose everything that makes us prosperous and free. **[That’s why I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within when you donate $35 or more to the Freedom Center today and give us the ammunition we need to expose the Left’s evil agenda to every American patriot.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zrdbbbappijd762g6ns7k2u0h0r43qlf45rjcrp8_rp22sh2s8i6eob6cph61o75c5h2bs)** The Left is at war with America. They don’t simply disagree with us about how to make our country better – they want to destroy it to make way for their Marxist dystopia. Or in Obama’s own words “radically transform” America. **And they don’t care how much they have to lie, cheat or steal to achieve it.** So it’s up to patriots like you and me to expose the truth about the Left to our fellow Americans while we still can.
---
| | Sincerely,
---
---
David Horowitz

subject: Kids deserve better…
body:
Parents send their children to school expecting them to learn about science, math, language arts, and history, NOT gender confusion.

|

| | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zh0idmjt04j510immqfm1d0o28tg0a5kfpaaaou0_rp22sh2s8i6eob6cph61o73cdh2bs "SkyTree Book Fairs")
Friend,

Parents send their children to school expecting them to learn about science, math, language arts, and history, NOT gender confusion.

The problem is that Scholastic, the nation's largest book fair provider, promotes books that do just that...

Here’s just a few of the titles they are currently promoting...
* _**A Darker Mischief:**_ a book about a poor, queer boy who joins a secret society with nefarious initiation rituals...

* _**The Ribbon Skirt:**_ which includes themes of LBGTQ+ gender identity confusion for young children...

* _**Red: A Crayon’s Story:**_ a book about a crayon labeled “red,” who feels blue and learns to be his “true blue self.”

Parents deserve a better option.

Luckily, SkyTree Book Fairs has the solution! We provide parents and schools with a trusted, values-driven alternative to the inappropriate books Scholastic pushes on children.

[Your donation of $10, $35, $50, or more today will help us provide a wholesome and age-appropriate book fair experience to 150,000 kids this year. Click below to show your support >>](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z4m54iv2ageh87pttv2rk0b3hqs5lhr47f7jq3eo_rp22sh2s8i6eob6cph61o73cdh2bs)

Would you want your son or daughter, niece or nephew, grandchild, or student reading books about gender confusion at school?!

If the answer to that question is a resounding “NO,” then you’ll be happy to see what SkyTree Book Fairs has to offer.

**We only provide wholesome, age-appropriate books, free from confusing content or radical political agendas. **

Parents, grandparents, and school staff can rest assured that the only agenda SkyTree has is fostering a love of reading in the next generation through uplifting stories that build strong moral character while letting imaginations soar.

It’s no wonder that last fall alone, SkyTree received over 150 requests for book fairs from schools across the country!

subject: I’m not saying this to scare you
body:
America is on the brink of destruction.

| |
---
| | Fellow Patriot, America is on the brink of destruction. I don’t say this to shock or scare you – I say it because it’s true. _What we see today didn’t happen overnight. It’s the result of a movement that began with the Communist revolution in Russia and has been 100 years in the making..._ **...and Barack Obama hit the accelerator button, fast tracking their agenda.** I’d know better than most. When I was a young man, I was one of the leaders of the movement destroying America today. 50 years ago, I was a Marxist revolutionary bent on bringing America as we know it to an end. I stood side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited _Ramparts_ – radical Left's largest magazine. I marched, wrote manifestos, and attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam. My eyes opened to the incredible destruction and evil my “comrades” made possible. So I left and never looked back. I cast my 1984 ballot for Ronald Reagan – then I started the David Horowitz Freedom Center to fight the Left and I’ve dedicated the last 40 years to exposing them. Why? Because I knew first-hand the threat our country was facing. I knew what was at stake and I knew if I didn’t tell the American people what I knew, we would lose our country forever. That’s why I spent 6 months writing** _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_** – and I want you to have your very own copy of it. **[So I’m asking you to stand with me and make a generous, tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to my Freedom Center. As a thank you, I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within.](https://e.realamericanreporting.com/rd/9z2zjicstqquaqp2p0saah4f4kom9qvs7rec914amlo_rp22sh2s8i6eob6cpj60or0c3h2bs)** When you think of “the enemy within” you may think of Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi or even Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez...and you wouldn’t be wrong. But make no mistake: **The real mastermind is Barack Obama.** Barack Obama laid the groundwork for everything we’ve seen since 2020 back in 2008. Barack Obama led the destruction of our cities, cozying up to Black Lives Matter radicals and siding with criminals over police upholding the rule of law. Barack Obama championed the castration of our military, making us a laughingstock on the world stage. And Barack Obama was the true architect behind the bogus Russian collusion witch hunt. The devastation and destruction we see today has been over a decade in the making – but most of the American people have no clue what we’re up against. **That’s why I wrote _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_ to explain how communist and fascist Leftists infiltrated and overtook the Democrat Party...** ...how it has become a party of racism and hatred attacking the very foundations of our country... ... and how their ultimate goal is to create a one-party state – and cancel, deplatform and silence every last one of their political opponents by slandering them as “white supremacists” and worse. The reviews speak for themselves... “A Great Book” – Dinesh D’Souza “ _The Enemy Within_ is a book for all patriots who understand that our country is in a fight for its life.” – Mark Levin “David Horowitz does it again in a must-read for any American concerned about where we are headed as a nation.” Laura Ingraham I wrote _The Enemy Within_ because... I know if our country stands a chance, Americans must understand exactly how sinister and dangerous the new Democrat Party actually is. I was the enemy within — and I know in my bones what it will take to defeat them. We’ve reached the point in our history that will decide our future – and we either win these political battles or lose everything that makes us prosperous and free. **[That’s why I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within when you donate $35 or more to the Freedom Center today and give us the ammunition we need to expose the Left’s evil agenda to every American patriot.](https://e.realamericanreporting.com/rd/9z2zrff2e8an9p1qc8ih17p5fpif5s61332c24f2s00_rp22sh2s8i6eob6cpj60or0c3h2bs)** The Left is at war with America. They don’t simply disagree with us about how to make our country better – they want to destroy it to make way for their Marxist dystopia. Or in Obama’s own words “radically transform” America. **And they don’t care how much they have to lie, cheat or steal to achieve it.** So it’s up to patriots like you and me to expose the truth about the Left to our fellow Americans while we still can.
---
| | Sincerely,

David Horowitz

subject: Hollywood has done quite enough
body:

| | | You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with "entertainment" that grooms children.
---
| |

| | Fellow Conservative, As someone who's lived and worked in Hollywood my whole life, I want to say: **_You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with "entertainment" that grooms children._** Today when children turn on the TV, they see a Drag Queen leading the Pride Parade on _Blue's Clues_...
---
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zhkvmkcjaucljfim425jc9vit9e4jbq94e562pl0_rp22sh2s8i6eob6cpj64ob4c9h2bs)
---
| | And the result of this constant propaganda? An upside-down world where children lecture you on what you can and cannot say......and they try to "educate" YOU about your "old-fashioned" and "mean" ideas. But you and I know your ideas aren’t old-fashioned or mean at all. They are the same biblical values that made America the greatest country on earth. **That’s why I’m reaching out to you. Today you have a very special chance to stop the Hollywood groomers who are turning our children and grandchildren against us and the Godly values we love. ** **[**Today, I'm inviting you to be a Founding Supporter of the very first children's television show that actively fights back against the groomers in Hollywood AND reinforces the traditional biblical values that made America great.**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zf7qgp2msj1en3eb6th43gb3j2jqatlmfqroft9g_rp22sh2s8i6eob6cpj64ob4c9h2bs)** And it's only possible with the help of motivated Christians who want to see a Christian resurgence in America like you. Introducing: _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_. This ground-breaking live-action television show captivates children... ...but more importantly, it builds their character at the same time. Imagine a children's show that leaves your child or grandchild with a greater sense of right and wrong and an understanding of truth. Courage, honesty, discernment, forgiveness, empathy, all taught through a biblical and traditional lens. Imagine a children's show that brings families together instead of driving them apart. Now imagine YOU are the one who makes that show possible. **[**Because I can't beat the Hollywood groomers without your help as a Founding Supporter.**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zap9k2061hdh3lobvbeu8l475a5m4b29kuqet9oo_rp22sh2s8i6eob6cpj64ob4c9h2bs)** Season One of _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ has ten lesson-filled episodes planned. And each episode costs around $70,000 to produce. I know that's a lot of money but it's actually a fraction of what it would cost if we made our show with a major Hollywood studio. And obviously we won’t work through Hollywood. Hollywood has done quite enough already to destroy American culture and hijack our children. We parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens must take over to rebuild a thriving, healthy, GOOD and GODLY culture. **[That's why I'm asking you to contribute $35, $50, $250, $500, or more to help us reach our fundraising goal of $70,000 per episode.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z19njrjtkikqt7kv28qb0paac8a6idgs3v6t8lt0_rp22sh2s8i6eob6cpj64ob4c9h2bs) ** Whether you can send $35, $50,000, or anything in between, or anything higher or lower -- please know that gifts of EVERY size are needed and greatly appreciated. As your special "Thank You" for joining me as a **Founding Supporter** at the $35 and above level, we’ll send you**** all ten episodes of** _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ **for your family to enjoy**** FREE on DVD.** ** Hollywood groomers have destroyed America's Godly culture. But today we rebuild from the ashes. And it starts by ensuring the most innocent among us are filled with faith and family -- not filth. Thank you for joining us as a **Founding Supporter. **

Dear Hello Five days including today, we must turn in our petitions and we must have your petitions in hand for it to count.
THIS Thursday, April 3 by 5pm we must turn in our signatures to the Virginia State Board of Elections.
I just finished counting the sheets of petitions turned in thus far. And I know many of you still have outstanding petitions and plan to collect more signatures today. I also know many of you are going to hand deliver your petitions or expedite all petitions so that we will receive them before midnight Wednesday.
While we have worked tirelessly around the clock going to event after event collecting signatures, getting very little sleep and driving hours and hours every single day since we announced a run 3 weeks ago, we are still short signatures.
Thankfully, we still have 4 more days. Today, we will be at NASCAR and the Hampton Gun Show. We still need a minimum of 4,000 signatures before we turn these petitions in on Thursday.
We really need all hands on deck to meet our goal. We can do this if you help.
Thank you to everyone who has already mailed or overnighted your petitions. I appreciate you and I am keeping a list of those who have collected signatures so that we remember those of you who have helped in this tremendous effort. We will be having a dinner at our house sometime in late April or early May for those who have collected over 100 signatures.
Many of you already know what's at stake here. Remember 2020? Do you remember when the Democrats had an unfettered oligarchical trifecta in the House, Senate AND Democrat Ralph Northam was governor? He signed into law every Democrat bill that came across his desk. It seriously triggers me to remember all of the bills I personally witnessed pass in 2020. Many of those laws are still in effect because we couldn't reverse them.
So are you going to give up or are you going to fight?
Many Trump supporters have already said they cannot in good conscience support our Lieutenant Governor Winsome Sears because of her harsh anti-Trump comments .
They can't forget her words.
While you personally may have overlooked her comments, I hear many Trump supporters say they can't get over it.
If we don't get enough signatures to get on the ballot, we are destined to repeat history, with Spanberger for Governor. I'm just being honest here. It's not politically correct to say this, but it is the truth.
If we don't get the necessary signatures turned in before this coming Thursday, you will have to relive 2020 all over again. Many have said they are going to move out of Virginia if Spanberger gets elected in November. Don't shoot the messenger. That's what a number of Virginians are saying.
NOW is the time to do something. What is the cost of moving out of Virginia compared to the effort it will take for you and your family to collect 100 signatures and turn them into our campaign before this Wednesday at midnight. Which is more inconvenient? Living under a Democrat trifecta? Moving out of Virginia? Collecting 100 signatures? The choice is yours. I really can't do this on my own.
Virginia is the most beautiful state in the United States. I don't want to move out of Virginia. Do you? The Democrats have already passed tyrannical bills in both the House and Senate. This was the last session Governor Youngkin could veto those bills. Now his term is up. Governor Youngkin cannot run this time and he will not be there in January to veto these bills.
I'm begging you to put aside all excuses. Trust me. We all have good excuses why we can't circulate a petition. But excuses don't get us to our goal. Please do your part or we are destined to repeat 2020.
TODAY IS THE LAST SUNDAY TO COLLECT SIGNATURES. You can still collect through Wednesday, but we need in hand before midnight Wednesday. But you will need to hand deliver. We must turn in our forms before 5pm this Thursday.
TODAY IS THE LAST DAY to collect signatures at the Hampton Gun Show and just off the NASCAR property this weekend.
* Please call 804 370 8727 or
* email amanda@chaseforva.com if you can volunteer.

Anyone can get members of their household to sign a petition, get it notarized and Fed Ex it to our Appomattox campaign office. At this point you will need to overnight or FedEx your petitions. I wouldn't count on the postal service to deliver your petitions in time.
Just remember. You can't sign your own petition. Also, the petition must be notarized before you mail it in.
We STILL need committed volunteers going to busy shopping centers, church parking lots and anywhere there are many people gathered in line and waiting.
Please do your part to ensure we collect enough signatures to make sure we cross the finish line when we hand in our petitions next Thursday, April 3 before 5pm.
Please stop by the following locations to sign Amanda's petition:

THIS WEEKEND Please stop by the Hampton Gun Show today to sign the petition to get my name on the ballot or drop off your notarized petitions.
We will have a booth, so please drop by and pick up a free sweatshirt or t-shirt while supplies last. I will be at NASCAR TODAY but have volunteers at the gun show the entire time. If you would like to volunteer, please give us call at 804 370-8727 or email amanda@chaseforva.com.
TODAY, Sunday, March 30 Hampton Gun Show Hampton Roads Convention Center 1610 Coliseum Drive Hampton, VA 23666 Sunday 10-4pm
If there are other large gatherings of 100 or more people, where we could collect signatures, please email us at amanda@chaseforva.com or call 804 370 8727.
TODAY, Sunday, March 30 Martinsville 3pm NASCAR Race, 340 Speedway Road, Ridgeway, VA 24148
* We need volunteers from 11am through 5pm.

10:15-11:30am, Falls Church GOP Petition Drive, 602 Dorchester Road, Falls Church, VA 22046

Unable to attend? If you would like to sign my petition, but you are unable to attend one of these events, you can simply print off the petition, and get your family members to sign. Remember. You cannot sign your own petition.
Please print off the petition at[ www.chaseforgovernor.com ](https://byh4wqwab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001kRXM58QWLr6jMloHjbiy9LBWbX4Byx9DsQ-u2tOLWWpWxdCD7krBGkq9Qo6bu0I5tR_S2m4zG9aaxavodatgVVO3x2IfVbMuZ09sEJeDI_QOM5QCTDr6qAQoYnDme8sSeDKy25tqYvRQdkaU2rjiuepW0WcLffLI&c=bRpgPyE1SsrG_J9j3Z6e7R-gazT42EbnaxAEJUjXU5FN3bQ_Jyygxg==&ch=DcxqDuJ9wa-UQ4MbedxtkhgI8aYHkLHXSFS1kVL1nI_mBbzq9rujJg==)so that it is double sided and then collect signatures, but you can't sign your own petition, witness each signature, get it notarized and Fed Ex it to our Appomattox campaign office to:
Friends of Amanda Chase 2023 Church Street #250 Appomattox, VA 24522
Give us a call at 804 370 8727 and we will walk you through what to do, or you can read instructions below.
WE CANNOT COLLECT SIGNATURES ONLINE.
Signatures must be witnessed in person by signing an old fashioned paper petition ballot.
Are you ready to say yes? Here's what you need to do:

1. Print off the attached form on one sheet of paper, front and back. Double sided only.
2. YOU cannot sign your own petition. Please sign someone else's petition.
3. Witness your friends, family and neighbors sign the petition form.
4. Please make sure they actually sign the form.
5. Please also make sure their writing is legible so that signatures can be verified.
6. You must also witness every signature and visit your local bank to have a notary sign off on your petition form before mailing.
7. Keep in mind that you can't sign your own petition form.
8. Please collect signatures by[ Congressional District.](https://byh4wqwab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001kRXM58QWLr6jMloHjbiy9LBWbX4Byx9DsQ-u2tOLWWpWxdCD7krBGp-WNFHNQ_GS3l83jRhW9aPDaeTNb82pzsgW2gl0390KZyFhb56YJgvw6A3KSmOhNkVnZmKrhMZsk5bNtK3wth7634UOtDx87-sCXh4iQVpnPEd_FFEwL5nVOhZuRy_jviQsih_R0c_I76--9tVPgMc=&c=bRpgPyE1SsrG_J9j3Z6e7R-gazT42EbnaxAEJUjXU5FN3bQ_Jyygxg==&ch=DcxqDuJ9wa-UQ4MbedxtkhgI8aYHkLHXSFS1kVL1nI_mBbzq9rujJg==) One Congressional District per form. You can write the Congressional District in the upper right hand corner.
9. Get the petition notarized at your local bank for free.
10. Please send us the original, not a photocopy.
11. Drop the petition off in person to: 2023 Church Street, Appomattox, VA 24522
12. Or Fed Ex the petition to:

Friends of Amanda Chase 2023 Church Street #250 Appomattox, VA 24522

THIS Thursday, April 3 by 5pm we must turn in our signatures to the Virginia State Board of Elections. I just finished counting the sheets of petitions turned in thus far. And I know many of you still have outstanding petitions and plan to collect more signatures today. I also know many of you are going to hand deliver your petitions or expedite all petitions so that we will receive them before midnight Wednesday. While we have worked tirelessly around the clock going to event after event collecting signatures, getting very little sleep and driving hours and hours every single day since we announced a run 3 weeks ago, we are still short signatures. Thankfully, we still have 4 more days. Today, we will be at NASCAR and the Hampton Gun Show. We still need a minimum of 4,000 signatures before we turn these petitions in on Thursday. We really need all hands on deck to meet our goal. We can do this if you help. Thank you to everyone who has already mailed or overnighted your petitions. I appreciate you and I am keeping a list of those who have collected signatures so that we remember those of you who have helped in this tremendous effort. We will be having a dinner at our house sometime in late April or early May for those who have collected over 100 signatures. Many of you already know what's at stake here. Remember 2020? Do you remember when the Democrats had an unfettered oligarchical trifecta in the House, Senate AND Democrat Ralph Northam was governor? He signed into law every Democrat bill that came across his desk. It seriously triggers me to remember all of the bills I personally witnessed pass in 2020. Many of those laws are still in effect because we couldn't reverse them. So are you going to give up or are you going to fight? Many Trump supporters have already said they cannot in good conscience support our Lieutenant Governor Winsome Sears because of her harsh anti-Trump comments . They can't forget her words. While you personally may have overlooked her comments, I hear many Trump supporters say they can't get over it. If we don't get enough signatures to get on the ballot, we are destined to repeat history, with Spanberger for Governor. I'm just being honest here. It's not politically correct to say this, but it is the truth. If we don't get the necessary signatures turned in before this coming Thursday, you will have to relive 2020 all over again. Many have said they are going to move out of Virginia if Spanberger gets elected in November. Don't shoot the messenger. That's what a number of Virginians are saying. NOW is the time to do something. What is the cost of moving out of Virginia compared to the effort it will take for you and your family to collect 100 signatures and turn them into our campaign before this Wednesday at midnight. Which is more inconvenient? Living under a Democrat trifecta? Moving out of Virginia? Collecting 100 signatures? The choice is yours. I really can't do this on my own. Virginia is the most beautiful state in the United States. I don't want to move out of Virginia. Do you? The Democrats have already passed tyrannical bills in both the House and Senate. This was the last session Governor Youngkin could veto those bills. Now his term is up. Governor Youngkin cannot run this time and he will not be there in January to veto these bills. I'm begging you to put aside all excuses. Trust me. We all have good excuses why we can't circulate a petition. But excuses don't get us to our goal. Please do your part or we are destined to repeat 2020. TODAY IS THE LAST SUNDAY TO COLLECT SIGNATURES. You can still collect through Wednesday, but we need in hand before midnight Wednesday. But you will need to hand deliver. We must turn in our forms before 5pm this Thursday. TODAY IS THE LAST DAY to collect signatures at the Hampton Gun Show and just off the NASCAR property this weekend. Please call 804 370 8727 or email amanda@chaseforva.com if you can volunteer. Anyone can get members of their household to sign a petition, get it notarized and Fed Ex it to our Appomattox campaign office. At this point you will need to overnight or FedEx your petitions. I wouldn't count on the postal service to deliver your petitions in time. Just remember. You can't sign your own petition. Also, the petition must be notarized before you mail it in. We STILL need committed volunteers going to busy shopping centers, church parking lots and anywhere there are many people gathered in line and waiting. Please do your part to ensure we collect enough signatures to make sure we cross the finish line when we hand in our petitions next Thursday, April 3 before 5pm. Please stop by the following locations to sign Amanda's petition: THIS WEEKEND Please stop by the Hampton Gun Show today to sign the petition to get my name on the ballot or drop off your notarized petitions. We will have a booth, so please drop by and pick up a free sweatshirt or t-shirt while supplies last. I will be at NASCAR TODAY but have volunteers at the gun show the entire time. If you would like to volunteer, please give us call at 804 370-8727 or email amanda@chaseforva.com. name: David Horowitz
subject: the enemy within
body:
America is on the brink of destruction.

| |
---
| | Fellow Patriot, America is on the brink of destruction. I don’t say this to shock or scare you – I say it because it’s true. _What we see today didn’t happen overnight. It’s the result of a movement that began with the Communist revolution in Russia and has been 100 years in the making..._ **...and Barack Obama hit the accelerator button, fast tracking their agenda.** I’d know better than most. When I was a young man, I was one of the leaders of the movement destroying America today. 50 years ago, I was a Marxist revolutionary bent on bringing America as we know it to an end. I stood side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited _Ramparts_ – radical Left's largest magazine. I marched, wrote manifestos, and attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam. My eyes opened to the incredible destruction and evil my “comrades” made possible. So I left and never looked back. | | Fellow Patriot, America is on the brink of destruction. I don't say this to shock or scare you - I say it because it's true. _What we see today didn 't happen overnight. It's the result of a movement that began with the Communist revolution in Russia and has been 100 years in the making..._ **... and Barack Obama hit the accelerator button, fast tracking their agenda.** I'd know better than most. When I was a young man, I was one of the leaders of the movement destroying America today. 50 years ago, I was a Marxist revolutionary bent on bringing America as we know it to an end. I stood side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited _Ramparts_ - radical Left's largest magazine. I marched, wrote manifestos, and attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam. My eyes opened to the incredible destruction and evil my "comrades" made possible. So I left and never looked back. I cast my 1984 ballot for Ronald Reagan - then I started the David Horowitz Freedom Center to fight the Left and I've dedicated the last 40 years to exposing them. Why? **_Around the World_**
---
Hello, friend! Welcome back to _Around the World_ —the email series that cuts through the noise and exposes how global events are shaping the fight for America’s future. These aren’t just headlines—they’re battles that decide policy, elections, and the very survival of our democracy. Every Sunday, I, Olya Makarova, break down the biggest power moves in foreign policy, the global shifts that impact U.S. politics, and the voter trends you can’t afford to ignore. The brutality of imperialism doesn't happen in isolation; it is sustained by those who choose to look away. They shape our policies, influence our elections, and test the very principles we claim to stand for. **_Around the World_ gives you the hard-hitting insights to stay informed, stay ahead, and stay in the fight. Let’s get into it.**
---
| | | | **The Ruthless Assault on Gaza**
---
|
---
On March 18, 2025, the Gaza ceasefire collapsed as Israeli forces launched a full-scale military assault across the Strip. The breakdown followed failed negotiations in Doha: Hamas sought a broader agreement to end hostilities, while Israel pushed only for a limited extension focused on hostage releases. Tensions had already escalated — Israel blocked humanitarian aid for over two weeks, and a March 15 airstrike killed journalists and aid workers, which Hamas called a deliberate effort to derail the truce. The humanitarian fallout has been catastrophic. Over 400 Palestinians were killed on March 18 alone, and more than 500 wounded, as Israeli airstrikes hit homes, shelters, and hospitals. Entire communities were displaced again, with over 140,000 people fleeing into overcrowded camps lacking clean water, electricity, or medical care. The north-south Salahuddin Road was severed by Israeli forces, further isolating civilians. Hospitals remain on the brink of collapse under the weight of casualties, while Gazan children reportedly draw pictures of food in the sand, awaiting food aid that remains under blockade. Israel claims the renewed offensive aims to pressure Hamas into releasing hostages. Yet, even as Hamas held its fire for two days after the bombing resumed, Israeli forces expanded into both northern and southern Gaza. By March 20, Hamas resumed rocket fire, citing self-defense. Meanwhile, protests against Hamas have erupted in parts of Gaza, driven by exhaustion over endless war and deepening humanitarian misery. This war was not inevitable. It was a consequence of political decisions, including Israel’s expansionist approach and Washington’s blank-check support. The international community must demand accountability, not only for the destruction in Gaza but for those who enable it. A just peace requires sustained diplomacy, protection of civilians, and recognition that Palestinian lives are not expendable. **Join us next week for the latest updates and stay informed with NDLB!**

Welcome back to Around the World —the email series that cuts through the noise and exposes how global events are shaping the fight for America’s future. These aren’t just headlines—they’re battles that decide policy, elections, and the very survival of our democracy. Every Sunday, I, Olya Makarova, break down the biggest power moves in foreign policy, the global shifts that impact U.S. politics, and the voter trends you can’t afford to ignore. The brutality of imperialism doesn't happen in isolation; it is sustained by those who choose to look away. They shape our policies, influence our elections, and test the very principles we claim to stand for. Around the World gives you the hard-hitting insights to stay informed, stay ahead, and stay in the fight. Let’s get into it. | | | | The Ruthless Assault on Gaza | On March 18, 2025, the Gaza ceasefire collapsed as Israeli forces launched a full-scale military assault across the Strip. The breakdown followed failed negotiations in Doha: Hamas sought a broader agreement to end hostilities, while Israel pushed only for a limited extension focused on hostage releases. Tensions had already escalated — Israel blocked humanitarian aid for over two weeks, and a March 15 airstrike killed journalists and aid workers, which Hamas called a deliberate effort to derail the truce. The humanitarian fallout has been catastrophic. Over 400 Palestinians were killed on March 18 alone, and more than 500 wounded, as Israeli airstrikes hit homes, shelters, and hospitals. Entire communities were displaced again, with over 140,000 people fleeing into overcrowded camps lacking clean water, electricity, or medical care. The north-south Salahuddin Road was severed by Israeli forces, further isolating civilians. Hospitals remain on the brink of collapse under the weight of casualties, while Gazan children reportedly draw pictures of food in the sand, awaiting food aid that remains under blockade. Israel claims the renewed offensive aims to pressure Hamas into releasing hostages. Yet, even as Hamas held its fire for two days after the bombing resumed, Israeli forces expanded into both northern and southern Gaza. By March 20, Hamas resumed rocket fire, citing self-defense. Meanwhile, protests against Hamas have erupted in parts of Gaza, driven by exhaustion over endless war and deepening humanitarian misery. This war was not inevitable. It was a consequence of political decisions, including Israel’s expansionist approach and Washington’s blank-check support. The international community must demand accountability, not only for the destruction in Gaza but for those who enable it. A just peace requires sustained diplomacy, protection of civilians, and recognition that Palestinian lives are not expendable. | |

| | Fellow Patriot, America is on the brink of destruction. I don’t say this to shock or scare you – I say it because it’s true. _What we see today didn’t happen overnight. That’s why I spent 6 months writing** _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_** – and I want you to have your very own copy of it. **[So I’m asking you to stand with me and make a generous, tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to my Freedom Center. But make no mistake: **The real mastermind is Barack Obama.** Barack Obama laid the groundwork for everything we’ve seen since 2020 back in 2008. Barack Obama led the destruction of our cities, cozying up to Black Lives Matter radicals and siding with criminals over police upholding the rule of law. Barack Obama championed the castration of our military, making us a laughingstock on the world stage. And Barack Obama was the true architect behind the bogus Russian collusion witch hunt. The devastation and destruction we see today has been over a decade in the making – but most of the American people have no clue what we’re up against. **That’s why I wrote _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_ to explain how communist and fascist Leftists infiltrated and overtook the Democrat Party...** ...how it has become a party of racism and hatred attacking the very foundations of our country... ... and how their ultimate goal is to create a one-party state – and cancel, deplatform and silence every last one of their political opponents by slandering them as “white supremacists” and worse. I know if our country stands a chance, Americans must understand exactly how sinister and dangerous the new Democrat Party actually is. I was the enemy within — and I know in my bones what it will take to defeat them. We’ve reached the point in our history that will decide our future – and we either win these political battles or lose everything that makes us prosperous and free. **[That’s why I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within when you donate $35 or more to the Freedom Center today and give us the ammunition we need to expose the Left’s evil agenda to every American patriot.](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/s/c/pQ7guPD7kljBj3UDXTAfb6AMi1Ur_qBwnghW8WTQHUM06aNnab1mD8IVL5efTdMdlz-px_Z0KQxeKDFEqT5p1pq7vCNfmICXPSSLNgXUFWXoAXh_-YybQdprCkzBTLDgyRnkwRSFOugvVlsur63bFLnGaUf3pMRr8V4shPpQAgn_1NO7_JFay4hRaK-YbV_qqjUB6L6LP6bLihEI7AkLAdrJfAcGk-fv8MOtMxIYAW08WbkbBqAb5Mj11RZMRTgTztfbJoXfERcURXTHbhJ9IP0tj-wzFLCYl3US7uFsN8gcv3dPk-la8-zIhRZoMOFwvIW9Z6CV-TB8mxn-tzNzQ6h_m2e6vFchxDMTHAT9OD-IDewEuSLMpVHWXKYklPFOJD63Fab5yPADxcKbG4nTnr5hiPZunbL8Xa7LSHE4ouxTN1f3qQzN9yBvKpp_Wcssl4P9YvOoHm-hsXuNK9v-fpfzHf4Btk-2DREOyzfARvU/y2wyhuIDUfCMvYgSwqcVAUAcbkUDpPDn/7)** The Left is at war with America. Or in Obama’s own words “radically transform” America. **And they don’t care how much they have to lie, cheat or steal to achieve it.** So it’s up to patriots like you and me to expose the truth about the Left to our fellow Americans while we still can.

subject: The U.S. and Soviet Union also had a "hole race"
body:
As the United States and the Soviet Union started competing for space supremacy in the mid-20th century, they were also racing in the opposite direction.
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?xtl=1krv9cfc68eoagtb8fxef3zytcgsdlw9ikmrr2itam075vcp0xmjgkqkjq1nt8xyb0kpk7k8wpulaq90ykbz041vmoojv8mqwqwj8n5d06sy9eusen9o1qls9orr45xic1l7ndu2j621mcand5ibiuztp&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stxo9b&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)

# [There was a “hole race” alongside the space race.](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stxo9b&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
### [Science & Industry](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stxo9b&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stxo9b&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
| A s the United States and the Soviet Union started competing for space supremacy in the mid-20th century, they were also racing in the opposite direction. Both countries wanted to dig the [deepest hole](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stxo9b&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com), with the goal of reaching the Earth’s mantle in order to better understand the planet’s interior and also demonstrate technical prowess. A group of American scientists took a first stab at the deep hole in 1961 by drilling into a deep sea bed, where the Earth’s crust is thinner. The Soviet Union, after years of planning, started drilling a hole on the Kola Peninsula in the Arctic Circle in 1970. Eventually, the Germans launched their own effort in Bavaria in 1990.
---
Ultimately, nobody reached the Earth’s mantle. The Soviet Union still finished on top: Around 1989, after drilling the Kola Superdeep Borehole for about 20 years, the Soviets reached a [depth](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stxo9b&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) of about 7.5 miles. The hole is only about 9 inches across, too small for a human being to fall in, but it was sealed up with a metal cap in 2008 anyway. It’s still the deepest human-made hole on Earth.
The United States made it [601 feet](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stxo9b&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) deep under 11,700 feet of water before funding was pulled in 1967, although the project helped launch a new era of ocean exploration and brought up some valuable geological samples. Germany drilled more than [5.5 miles](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stxo9b&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com), but the drill got too hot to continue — a lower temperature is one advantage the Soviet Union had in the Arctic Circle. All of these efforts helped pave the way for future scientific drilling projects, ushering in technology that is still used by the oil and gas industry.
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stxo9b&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) | [](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stxo9b&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)

## More than a million acres of swampland was drained to create the Missouri Bootheel.
Before 1914, the Missouri Bootheel, a little panhandle at the southeast corner of the state, was a massive, 1.65 million-acre swamp fed by the Missouri River. Then one of the biggest drainage projects in the world transformed the land into the agricultural center it is today. In the early 20th century, landowners, many of whom were logging companies that had cleared the swamp’s hardwood forests, organized a massively ambitious drainage district. The digging started in 1914 and lasted until 1928, during which workers ultimately dug 900 miles of ditches and built 304 miles of levees, which currently drain 1.2 million acres of land. At the time, the environmental impact of swamps wasn’t as well understood as it is today, and while the farmland created by the project produces about a third of Missouri’s economic output, it did diminish the habitat for many wildlife species. Only around [84,000 acres](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stxo9b&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) of the original swamp remain today, and much of it is in conservation districts.

The Soviet Union, after years of planning, started drilling a hole on the Kola Peninsula in the Arctic Circle in 1970. Eventually, the Germans launched their own effort in Bavaria in 1990. Ultimately, nobody reached the Earth’s mantle. The Soviet Union still finished on top: Around 1989, after drilling the Kola Superdeep Borehole for about 20 years, the Soviets reached a of about 7.5 miles. The hole is only about 9 inches across, too small for a human being to fall in, but it was sealed up with a metal cap in 2008 anyway. It’s still the deepest human-made hole on Earth. The United States made it deep under 11,700 feet of water before funding was pulled in 1967, although the project helped launch a new era of ocean exploration and brought up some valuable geological samples. Germany drilled more than , but the drill got too hot to continue — a lower temperature is one advantage the Soviet Union had in the Arctic Circle. All of these efforts helped pave the way for future scientific drilling projects, ushering in technology that is still used by the oil and gas industry. | By clicking a link in this email, you're agreeing to our and . By the Numbers | | Year drilling began on the Kola Superdeep Borehole 1970 | | Year Yuri Gagarin became the first human in space 1961 | Year Yuri Gagarin became the first human in space 1961 | | Depth (in meters) of Xiaozhai Tiankeng, the world’s deepest sinkhole 660 | | Holes in a standard round of golf 18 | Holes in a standard round of golf 18 | | | Did you know? ---|---|--- More than a million acres of swampland was drained to create the Missouri Bootheel. Before 1914, the Missouri Bootheel, a little panhandle at the southeast corner of the state, was a massive, 1.65 million-acre swamp fed by the Missouri River. Then one of the biggest drainage projects in the world transformed the land into the agricultural center it is today. In the early 20th century, landowners, many of whom were logging companies that had cleared the swamp’s hardwood forests, organized a massively ambitious drainage district. The digging started in 1914 and lasted until 1928, during which workers ultimately dug 900 miles of ditches and built 304 miles of levees, which currently drain 1.2 million acres of land. At the time, the environmental impact of swamps wasn’t as well understood as it is today, and while the farmland created by the project produces about a third of Missouri’s economic output, it did diminish the habitat for many wildlife species. Only around of the original swamp remain today, and much of it is in conservation districts. USO Supporter,
We are immensely grateful for this community's generosity last year, but it was a difficult year for nonprofit organizations like the USO.
**[As we end our first quarter of the year, I'm reaching out to ask you to show your support for American military heroes with a generous donation today.](https://links.e.uso.)**
Please let me explain.
Rising conflict, unexpected deployments and natural disasters increased the demand for USO programs and services in 2024. The hard truth is that it costs the USO $225,000 per day to facilitate the programming needed to support the brave men and women serving our country. And with costs continuing to rise, we want to make sure we can meet the growing demand to support service members in 2025 and beyond.
**[That's why we set an urgent goal to raise $60,000 via email and text message by midnight tomorrow and why I'm personally asking you: Will you please donate $29 or more to the USO now?](https://links.e.uso.)**
When I served in the U.S. Air Force, I was deployed on and off for seven years and missed many precious moments with my family. So, when I think of today's deployed service members spending special moments like Thanksgiving and Christmas away from family or missing the birth of a child, I know firsthand how important the USO's programs can truly be.
From keeping them connected to home through calls and video chats to providing holiday meals and care packages, the USO's programs can make a life-changing difference when our heroes need it most.
But many people don't realize that the USO is a nonprofit organization that relies on generous donors to fuel our support of service members and their families.
**That 's why I'm personally reaching out to you with this urgent request: [Please, will you make a generous gift now to support our brave military heroes as they serve our country?](https://links.e.uso.)**
[SUPPORT OUR HEROES NOW](https://links.e.uso.org/els/v2/~8eXC0r9R~Hm/UmVQMnVaZlpLWTVoYWNDY2VESk51UUUzdlJMdk1YamxUOGs0aVBYZTJXTGNzKzF5WDJFeEtQZjNRLytaTTA5ODdsK1VnRHR2QytNelJYbEZnbTJ5cExZdVZFc2xESE1FbXNDWVNqT1o4bUk9S0/czkrNis4THlpMkNFREcyb1dERy8xT0t3bGJOK0cwOWtlZGI3TXd0cjBtL3BaaTVSNHdhb2xuSEorTjFqR1BWZzVtVUY1OWZtZG1QVFQyR2lldDlWdjliaTJrNzlyQ0FNS0)
---
Thank you for your generosity to those who serve,
Christopher Plamp, USAF Retired

👋🏻 Friends -
To everyone who cares about the gun violence prevention movement, please don’t click away from this important message.

We know you’re probably getting a LOT of emails right now, so we’ll get right to it: [**We're asking you to make your first online contribution to GIFFORDS.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-dec24.MAKoxe&refcode=em241230-1-b&t=1&akid=10249%2E3935704%2EWNAt_-)

Here’s why:
Tomorrow at midnight, we close the books on our first quarterly fundraising deadline since Donald Trump became president. As of now, our fundraising has slowed considerably and we're hoping to turn it around before it's too late.
This deadline is important because people look at our fundraising numbers. Republicans want to know if we have the resources to fight back.
So we have one more day to bring in as many donations as we can to stop Trump from eroding existing gun safety laws and to make Republicans pay an electoral price if they do.
That’s where you come in.

name: The Editors at Broad + Liberty
subject: Why Lancaster just flipped blue
body:
News + editorial to start your week | Broad + Liberty Weekly Reads | | | |
---
| | | Good morning and welcome to _Broad + Liberty_ 's Weekly Reads.

Stay up to date on all of this and more when you[ subscribe to our daily email list ](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=c84d59a7b1&e=b7b3eddce2)and get the best of _Broad + Liberty_ delivered straight to your inbox.
---
|
---
|
### **1.[How Lancaster fell](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=4e02682339&e=b7b3eddce2)**
_By Kyle Sammin_
When Republican Ryan Aument ran for the state Senate in 2018, he won by 33 percentage points. In 2022, he was unopposed. But when he resigned at the end of 2024 to work for U.S. Senator Dave McCormick, his former seat flipped to a Democrat, James Malone, by a narrow margin of 482 votes.

How did this happen? Does it suggest larger changes in the Pennsylvania electorate? And will Malone be able to hold the seat when it comes up for election again in 2026?

**Why It Matters**. We don’t yet know from the election results who turned out, only that there were fewer of them. But it is clear from the data that one of two things happened: either the people of northern Lancaster County became fifteen percent more Democratic since November, or Democrats did a better job of turning out their people than Republicans.

It’s pretty clear that it’s the latter.

That’s important because it sends a message about how future campaigns in this state must be conducted. A generation ago, Republicans had a big advantage on high-propensity voters — the kind of people who never miss an election or a primary, year in and year out. Democrats had more of the every-four-years voter who only turns out for the big ones.

That’s flipped, another consequence of the party shift that has swept the nation since Trump came down the escalator in 2015 and announced he was running for President.

Pennsylvania Republicans: learn from this.

[Continue Reading](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=2d6d0f89d8&e=b7b3eddce2)
---
|
---
|
### **2.[Giving students fish and teaching principals to be fishermen](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=a11b6ff916&e=b7b3eddce2)**

_By Guy Ciarrocchi_
In 1996, Don Parsons, then Chairman and co-founder of CTDI, poked his head into his son Jerry’s office at CTDI and “volunteered” him to help the Sisters of the Immaculate Heart and the Archdiocese of Philadelphia build a brand new Bishop Shanahan high school (BSHS) in Downingtown. Today, nearly 1,000 students attend the three-story building on a multi-acre campus. Since that day, not only was BSHS built, but also a foundation was created with professional staff and a board of directors. Amazingly, nine-figures in donations have been raised and distributed to Catholic schools and to students of all faiths, across the five-county Archdiocese. The[ Foundation for Catholic Education](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=c86ecaf030&e=b7b3eddce2) (FCE) does all of that and more. Along the way, they’ve donated money to make Catholic education more affordable for tens of thousands of students, helped keep dozens of schools from closing, promoted programs for students with special needs, and created and distributed a robotics program (with support and direction from Bentley Systems in Exton). **Why It Matters.** True stewardship is donating one’s time, one’s treasurers and one’s talents — that is the embodiment of the 2025 version of the FCE. Since creating SPAT, the all too-recent heartbreaking process of closing elementary schools has stopped. And over the last few years, a historic change is happening. School enrollment is growing — even as families and schools are battling with inflation. Through gifts of money and expertise, the Catholic schools in the region are growing — again, serving children of all races and religions. When those schools stay open, not only are there opportunities for the local students, but also the community does not have an enormous, vacant, dark building sitting in its midst. **[Continue Reading](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=b9ba807e2c&e=b7b3eddce2)**
---
|
---
|
# **3\. Lightning Round**
* **[Wally Nunn: Waiting for the tooth fairy](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=9f584b6171&e=b7b3eddce2)**
* **[Christine Flowers: First, kill all the lawyers?](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=02c74a704c&e=b7b3eddce2)**
* **[Beth Ann Rosica: So much ado about nothing — closing the Dept of Ed might help students](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=4fb1d8ba62&e=b7b3eddce2)**
* **[Marisa Wise: Cyber school has been the best choice for me](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=aa8855bf57&e=b7b3eddce2)**
* **[Ben Mannes: The political malpractice of the Philadelphia Republican Party](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=3e3cb1c84a&e=b7b3eddce2)**
* **[Jeff Hurvitz: The world deserves to hear about America](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=80db2160b6&e=b7b3eddce2)**
* **[Thom Nickels: From hidden river to historic hills, Manayunk through the years](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=6fcc739283&e=b7b3eddce2)**
* **[Lawmakers’ perks: free Penn State football tickets](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=387941e7f8&e=b7b3eddce2)**
* **[Paul Davis: Springtime for armed robbers](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=b8d7799cf4&e=b7b3eddce2)**

---
|
---
|
# **4\. Podcast**
---
| [ ](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=430765edb5&e=b7b3eddce2)
---
| **U.S. Senator Dave McCormick** [appeared on The Volpe Report](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=5a97f29855&e=b7b3eddce2) this week to set the record straight on spending cuts and the falsehoods surrounding DOGE. [[Listen Now]](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=2d3bc9ff38&e=b7b3eddce2)
---
|
---
|
# **5\. What we're reading**
The first iPhone came out in 2007, and since that time it and other smart phones have slowly begun dominating our lives, sometimes for good, but often for ill. In 2024, people finally started pushing back at one of the most harmful aspects of the smart phone revolution: its stranglehold on our kids.
Social psychologist Jonathan Haidt led the way with his book, _The Anxious Generation_ , which laid out the problem and suggested some solutions. The book succeeded even beyond its author’s wildest dreams. As [Haidt and Zach Rausch write this week](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=3645284f47&e=b7b3eddce2) at _The Free Press_ , the message appealed to millions of parents and teachers who “were exhausted from competing for their students’ attention against platforms designed by multibillion-dollar companies to grab and hold attention.”

The book is one every parent should read. In the meantime, the article gives a breakdown about the new emerging norms on how to keep your kids’ phones from monopolizing their attention and distracting them from school, family, and many of the other good things in life.

For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government.

But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.

This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states.

These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over six million households and businesses nationwide with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;

Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College.

And this is especially important in this critical time for America's future.

So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.

And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work.

Please represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential Selection today. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty.

Larry P. Arnn

_**Unlike Virginia’s current leadership, I will always advocate for Virginia jobs and stand up for hardworking Virginians.**_

name: Deb Haaland
subject: We still have a long way to go
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Heartland Patriots (LucasKunce
body:
We’ve come so far.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/87439?refcode=em20250330-8853&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=8853%2E614464%2E9BzzX-)
Peter, it’s Deb Haaland. I’m running for Governor of New Mexico. Heartland Patriots said I could reach out to you.
As a 35th-generation New Mexican, I know firsthand the struggles that New Mexicans face.
I understand what it's like to be a single mother, having to decide between rent and groceries, struggling to keep a roof over your head.
I’m running to make life easier for our families and the future brighter for our kids.
My campaign is about lowering costs, making rent and housing affordable, strengthening our schools, and preventing crime so that you feel safe raising a family here. This is the future we all want and deserve for our beautiful state.
**The solutions are there if we are fierce enough to choose them.**
But we know we’ll have to build a campaign strong enough to get the future we deserve.
**That’s why our campaign is working hard to raise $150,000 online before our _first_ public fundraising deadline on April 7.** If we reach our goal, we’ll have the early resources we need to reach voters across New Mexico with our message and show those trying to flip New Mexico red that the people are on our side.
**[We’ve come so far since launching our campaign, but we still have a long way to go to hit our goal. I’m hoping I can count on your support. Will you split $10 between my campaign and Heartland Patriots today?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/87439?refcode=em20250330-8853&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=8853%2E614464%2E9BzzX-)**
Thank you for your generous support,
Deb

That’s why our campaign is working hard to raise $150,000 online before our first public fundraising deadline on April 7. Friend — it’s Ilhan.
As you probably know, our FEC fundraising deadline is tomorrow at midnight.
**[I’m humbly asking for your support before tomorrow.**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-mar25.Pez7ER&refcode=em250330-1-150&t=2&akid=1564%2E791427%2E9qvOtO)
Friend, this has never been easy.
I was raised in a refugee camp halfway across the world. Through good luck and hard work, my family came to the US and found a good life in Minnesota.
And despite that background, I became active in my community and eventually earned the privilege of serving in office.
Since then I’ve faced attacks and harassment from some of the most powerful people in the world; the President, Senators, House members, foreign leaders, oligarchs, multi-billion dollar media outlets and corporations, you name it.
I’ve dealt with the endless death threats, the insults, the people who think I’m not good enough, or not ‘from here’, and want me to hide away from public life.
**But through all of this, I’ve never backed down. Because I have you.**
This entire team and the movement we’ve built together has helped me push through and keep up the fight for our futures.
Because our progressive vision for this nation, where everyone is taken care of and provided the rights and dignity they deserve, is worth fighting for, despite it all.
So, with this crucial FEC deadline tomorrow, I’m counting on you to stand by my side, as you always have.
**[I’m humbly asking you to make a contribution of $3 or whatever you can afford today. Do it before our deadline tomorrow at midnight. It would make a huge difference.**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-mar25.Pez7ER&refcode=em250330-1-150&t=3&akid=1564%2E791427%2E9qvOtO)

I'm writing today to give you an update and to make a humble plea. _Look - this is from the bottom of my heart, so _please_ read this message to the end._ My team and I put together a historic win in 2021 to help flip all three of Virginia's highest offices red. Ever since becoming Lt. Governor, I've been logging big wins for my friends, neighbors, and every fellow Virginian. Now, I'm running for Governor so we can continue to keep up the amazing work we've been doing here in the Commonwealth and make history again. **But right now I have a few _SERIOUS_ challenges:**
---
**I was _legally_ barred from accepting even a dime in support of my campaign while I was in the Virginia legislative session.** But my Democrat opponent, Abigail Spanberger, was fundraising _**BIG TIME**_ while I was working hard in our capital. **Seriously** _**, a far-Left group injected $500K into Abigail Spanberger 's campaign coffers and there wasn't a thing I could do in response!**_

Now Spanberger has an _ENORMOUS_ fundraising advantage, Fellow American. Polls show this race is tied, but Spanberger has a serious cash advantage._If we don 't make up the difference, our conservative mission _will_ be cut short. _ **Today, I 'm making a plea to you as a Christian, a mother, and a Marine; _please send in any amount you can spare to support my campaign!_**

clean_body: We won’t back down in the fight for our rights. | | | Friend, Most Americans want to tax the rich and expand the programs that help people get by. People across the country are fighting back against harmful cuts to essential services. I’m uplifting their voices and demanding we move from a corporate oligarchy—where our basic needs like healthcare are privatized for profit—to a democratic economy that invests in people’s needs. As the richest people in the world are stealing from the working class, they’re trying to blame and scapegoat the most marginalized in our society, such as immigrants, Black and brown people, and trans people. This dehumanization is part of the fascist playbook, and it’s something we can all resist by demanding human dignity and human rights for all people. We must also speak up against escalating fascist attacks, as ICE and the Department of Homeland Security keep illegally abducting students and workers off the streets, without a shred of due process. Trump’s administration is also violating federal court orders and deporting immigrants to notorious overseas prisons. After tourists were denied entry and illegally detained for weeks, countries like the UK and Germany have issued travel warnings about the United States. Alongside the people suing the administration and protesting in the streets,I’m defending our rights in Congress. I’m demanding accountability from Trump, his corrupt allies, and members of his administration like the Secretary of Homeland Security. I will keep using my positions on** the House Financial Services Committee and the House Oversight Committee to stop Trump’s attacks. I will keep leading letters and introducing and co-sponsoring policies to restart funding and demand respect for our rights. I led fights to impeach Trump in his first term, and I will keep speaking out against his abuses of executive power. Each time he ignores court orders, it is illegal and unconstitutional. So is every attempt to dismantle federal agencies or stop Congressionally allocated funding without Congressional approval. I will stay loud and I will never back down in the fight for everyone’s rights. | While anti-democratic Republicans are avoiding their constituents and cancelling town halls, I’m continuing to engage with my community and share resources with my neighbors. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/T67b470bb-76ab-4cd3-8b01-675188ca6bf0/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)._
