| Dear friends, this is Gay Valimont, FL-1 candidate, and 2 days are what separates us from defending our values, if you would help. Today, I was reminded of a powerful symbol of freedom — the Statue of Liberty. Discussions about the statue’s return to France push a story that underscores our enduring bond with the values of _liberty, equality, and international friendship._ Although the details may seem symbolic, they carry a profound message: _our nation was built on these ideals, and we must never let them fade._
---
[](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tbd4778df-6473-43e1-8b79-71b46ef4d4e5/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
| Unfortunately, we’re also witnessing a disturbing twist in the “reclaim game.” While true leaders stand for the principles of justice and unity, figures like Donald Trump have tried to use the language of “reclaiming” American greatness for their own narrow, divisive purposes. His attempts to rewrite history and hijack our cherished symbols — using them to fuel partisan agendas — do nothing but diminish the true meaning of freedom. His shenanigans have already pinned our allies against us: “purchasing Greenland,” “renaming the Gulf,” and “making Canada a state” have all made us the pinnacle of division, not unity. Trump’s version of reclaiming power is all about exclusion and fear, not the inclusive, hopeful vision embodied by Lady Liberty. For me, the Statue of Liberty is more than just a monument — it’s a call to action. It represents the promise of a better life, the courage to fight for justice, and the commitment to protect every person’s right to freedom. As your candidate for Florida’s 1st District, I am determined to ensure that our government upholds these core principles both at home and abroad. As we face these challenges, let’s draw strength from the enduring symbolism of the Statue of Liberty. Let it remind us that the true meaning of our nation is not about reclaiming power for a select few, but about lifting up every person. [Your contribution, no matter the size, will help ensure that we continue to stand up for these timeless values. All we need is a $10 contribution to a split between Blue Amp Action and I, and your vote to ensure liberty and justice truly stays for all. ](https://default.salsalabs.org/T8a5730f0-af7f-44d6-a8af-6d9f485a22d0/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

Over the past decade it has infected democratic societies--including ours. It is as simple as it is terrifying: What we do now will define the future of our country and world. We at Blue Amp Action are dedicated to liberal, open societies, where reason and science are applied to solve our problems; where civil rights--including voting rights!--are protected for all. We fight for these values every day. Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits. **And savvy grassroots activists like you know, just like we do, that we can’t stop watching the people we help elect:_ after the elections, we have to keep organizing support for the policies we like and pushing back against the ones we don’t._** **__When the public tunes out between elections and the only people our elected officials hear from are the paid lobbyists of wealthy corporations, our government stops being accountable to the needs of ordinary families.__** **Democracy never sleeps, and neither can we.** So we ask that you support our work, so we can continue to engage in this fight every moment of every day. subject: On authoritarianism

body:
MAGA is committed to eliminating Democratic seats in Congress so Trump can continue his “revolution” without domestic opposition.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2511%2E4032634%2EKv1dnw)
---
This is our new reality: From classrooms to boardrooms to local governments and the press, Americans now fear political retribution from their own government. Think of the CEO who bends the knee after public threats of prosecution. Or the newspaper owner who decides it’s safer to bury editorial criticism of the President. The President and his lieutenants relish the power of intimidation. And they’re using it. Before my election to represent Georgia in the U.S. Senate, I led investigations of corruption and human rights abuses worldwide. More and more, the atmosphere under Trump reminds me of countries where dissent is silenced by intimidation. “We don’t want any trouble.” “We’re not sticking our necks out right now.” “We don’t need an investigation.” **These things should never be said in the United States.** During the confirmation hearings for RFK Jr., I noted the Republican Senate’s total capitulation to Trump. Then they confirmed a Trump loyalist to lead the FBI (for TEN YEARS) who is entering office having composed what many call an “enemies list” of MAGA’s adversaries. To lead the FBI. Only by regaining Congressional power can we reverse this. **Remember: in 2026, I’m the only Democratic U.S. Senator up for re-election in a state Trump won.** MAGA needs me defeated and gone. Help me defeat them in a landslide. Help fight back. [**Please split a contribution between my campaign and Elizabeth Warren today to defend this Senate seat and fight to end this corruption in our government.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2969?t=8&akid=2511%2E4032634%2EKv1dnw)

We’re throwing our support behind Susan Crawford. Here’s how you can help:

Peter,

There’s a critical race happening in Wisconsin this Tuesday that will determine the balance of the State Supreme Court. **We’re emailing you to tell you that In This Together PAC is throwing its support behind Susan Crawford.**

**[If you’d like to help fund our efforts to elect Susan, chip in right now>>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/104804541/536522049/-627450706?refcode=em25_250330_WIrace_fndd_gq_act___ITTP_ettx&&&&utm_campaign=em25_250330_WIrace_fndd_gq_act___ITTP_ettx&&&&utm_medium=email&&&&refcode2=c42244cc-780d-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&refcode2=c42244cc-780d-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTAzNjMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYzQyMjQ0Y2MtNzgwZC1mMDExLTkwY2QtMDAyMjQ4MmE5ZmI3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=szFakvaHTY5z21wRWNFVzeOcQCx6b6gRo_g6E53reds=)**

If you need more convincing, here’s everything you should know about this critical race:

Judge Susan Crawford and conservative-leaning Brad Schimel are neck-and-neck in the polls to be Wisconsin’s next Supreme Court Justice. Whoever wins will have a direct impact on critical issues across the state, from abortion rights and voting to union rights and worker protections and even redistricting for new congressional lines.

Donald Trump and Elon Musk are trying to buy this race for Schimel. Musk himself is spending $10 million in communications with voters, even going so low as to offer Wisconsin voters cash rewards.

In This Together is fighting back against Musk’s spending because we know how critical it is that common sense leaders like Susan aren’t drowned out by millions of dollars in ads paid for by the richest man on the planet. So we're pushing our own efforts to ensure voters know the truth about Susan’s record.

**We’re sending targeted campaign mail to voters across the state letting them know exactly why Susan is the right person for the job. Susan is focused on the issues, and is ready to make the tough decisions needed to protect the rights of _all_ Wisconsinites.**

On Tuesday, voters will head to the polls. Elon Musk is trying to tilt the scales, but we’re fighting back and making sure voters know the truth about Susan Crawford before they cast their ballots.

**[But all of this takes resources, and we’re up against millions of dollars from Elon Musk. So we need your help. _Our new reality —_
From classrooms to boardrooms to local governments and the press, Americans now fear political retribution from their own government.
Think of the CEO who bends the knee after public threats of prosecution. Or the newspaper owner who decides it’s safer to bury editorial criticism of the President.
The President and his lieutenants relish the power of intimidation. _And they’re using it._
***
Before my election to represent Georgia in the U.S. Senate, I led investigations of corruption and human rights abuses worldwide.
More and more, the atmosphere under Trump reminds me of countries where dissent is silenced by intimidation.
_“We don’t want any trouble.” “We’re not sticking our necks out right now.” “We don’t need an investigation.”_
**These things should never be said in the United States.**
***
During the confirmation hearings for RFK Jr., I noted the Republican Senate’s total capitulation to Trump.
Then they confirmed to lead the FBI (for TEN YEARS) a Trump loyalist who enters office having composed what many call an “enemies list” of MAGA’s adversaries.
_To lead the FBI._
***
Only by regaining Congressional power can we reverse this.
Remember: in 2026, I’m the only Democratic U.S. Senator up for re-election in a state Trump won.
MAGA needs me defeated and gone.
**_Help me defeat them in a landslide. Help fight back._**

name: Ruben Gallego
subject: Serious damage to our community
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
I’m glad you’re involved. It’s important. But the issue right now is most people don’t know everything that’s happening.
#

Peter,
Chances are if you’re reading this email you’re pretty tuned in to the news. Just by opening this email you’re already part of a unique group. You care about what’s happening — and you’re interested in doing more to improve things.
That’s really good, but it can also be tough. You know what’s happening right now — the thousands of government workers Elon Musk has fired for no reason. The plans to fire thousands more. Attacks on services that millions depend on, like Social Security, Medicaid, the VA. Further attacks on people who just want to live their lives and exercise their civil rights.
And you probably know why they’re doing it. To pass through trillions in tax cuts for the richest people and most profitable companies in the country. To worsen public services so people don’t trust them anymore — so they can privatize everything and extract all the value they can out of our country and leave nothing for the rest of us.
I’m glad you’re involved. It’s important. But the issue right now is most people don’t know everything that’s happening. They’re waking up early to go to work all day, cooking dinner, helping with homework, and then trying to find a few minutes of peace before bed. That’s enough work on its own.
And the real thing is, we have to reach those people. We have to show them the serious impacts that are coming to our community so that we can all stand up together and hold Trump accountable.
That’s why I did town halls all over Arizona this month. I wanted to go to our communities and tell people directly what’s happening, and hear from them in return. It’s why I’m doing so many interviews on TV, online, for magazines and newspapers.
We have to make sure they hear us, and it’s a lot of work. Honestly, it’s not cheap. So, when I’m asking you for a donation, it’s going to my team and our operations so that we can do this important work.
I really, really appreciate every donation we get. I grew up poor, and I know how important every dollar is. But, to keep going, I have to ask from time to time. That’s how we fund all of this.
And with our first FEC deadline of the year approaching fast, this is one of those times when I have to ask.
[**Please — could you chip in $5 so that we can keep going? It’d mean a lot if you could chip in before midnight tomorrow.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-mar25.cQPUMp&refcode=em250330-1-e&t=1&akid=3784%2E734936%2ESyIbW-)
_If you 've stored your info with ActBlue, we'll process your contribution instantly:_

I really appreciate it.
Ruben

Back in my college years, and even for a bit during my producing days, I was a semi-pro pool player. 🎱
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/104812285/536532913/628041926?refcode=em-3.30.25-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM1MzYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZWYyOTc4MGYtODAwZC1mMDExLTkwY2QtMDAyMjQ4MmE5ZmI3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=W6UE5UKcY6neCBUlcCsDI5H_3_M49ZVlyusps3wYJ1I=)
Believe it or not, some of the most important skills I developed at the pool table I still use today as a legislator. I learned that people like playing mind games when they want to win, and being one of the few women in a male-dominated sport taught me how to be strategic -- _and not be intimidated._

I've learned to stay focused on what winning actually means: _delivering results._
* I've been a champion for efforts to improve street safety, increase affordable housing stock, and protect our climate;

* I led the effort to improve transparency and keep people safer from sexual harassment and retaliation in the state assembly;

* I banned toxic, cancer causing ingredients from personal care products, children’s clothing & toys, and mattress;

* I’ve even taken on online ticket sellers to ensure Californians can see their favorite performers without price-gouging.

[I'm in Congress because we need proven, effective leaders in Washington who have a track record of delivering results. Local parents, teachers, and businesses all depended on it. If a severe storm hit, I knew what I said on TV might be the difference between life and death. **I’m not leaving anything to chance as we close in on this critical FEC deadline, either.** Year in and year out, this district is on the frontline in the fight for House control, a bellwether of the Midwest. We cannot take the chance that MAGA _expands_ its control of Congress, let alone keeps it. Working families, good-paying jobs, science as fact, a women’s right to reproductive freedom, the future of our democracy -- it all hangs in the balance. **Today marks the last day before our FIRST fundraising quarter since the Trump administration began. body:
Here are a few things I’m doing as a candidate, citizen, and organizer:

| If you no longer wish to hear from Emily Randall for Congress, you can [unsubscribe](https://secure.ngpvan.com/p/c9SZbdkbdUi3uhuNc8iU_A2?unsubscribedata=eytF0F8RErcEn%2B0rAZRIrBkayHZi366AIqSjo5yPKjFTRDZ6LEgtnKAgqJWE20oybBUxNcMelo6JdCJB07daZ8HblVIM0wVZG7MV2osGVNw0sMKY5%2FlZ4A59nf1%2FZQDwnCIcTWr6UHkQVx%2B4u9ApGhjR%2BJ3S25cMowdma5s1JnFE%2FOtUoXtSKYtT5zan3Bvtof5T0Q6jY5TL7WKtBGHy6BEims0D6cgF7DsuzVo5mPfq8Ob%2FQP%2BWGxeZ8JMF1aCCxNicChVpmEpE67HS1hC42qe1Yv2DK71IQGB2MQva3wo0wBWKvJr%2FxsWl9Nzr9J6PlsCN7UzVIPvTJpEqvlQ4ApsHaFCvD7SCKARfCiLhY2QyQQQU9uKuhlCCTbhdQtWxs3VKSDJDX7%2B3vItT9zSzt0AY%2F9BD646YqlY2OGEnmd47LYelHhx9nsskQEx5NO2j) at any time. Peter, So far this month, I’ve heard from roughly 4,000 constituents at seven town halls. Here are two points I heard over and over: 1\. Trump and Musk’s destruction of our public services, international alliances, and economy is a threat unlike anything we’ve seen before. 2\. **_Democrats in Congress aren’t doing enough. _** I wanted to let you know that **I hear you — loud and clear. ** I take the threats of the Trump administration very seriously. My mom is a paraeducator. My dad was a veteran and a federal employee at Puget Sound Naval Shipyard. My sister relied on Medicaid her whole life. I represent over 27,000 federal workers whose jobs are on Elon Musk’s chopping block. But as angry as I am, I’m also a pragmatist — which means recognizing what I can do IN Congress and what has to happen OUTSIDE Congress. In Congress, my Democratic colleagues and I meet, write letters, and use parliamentary procedure to fight against the worst of the Trump-Musk agenda. It’s slow, deliberative work that doesn’t make flashy headlines. I understand if it feels insufficient in this moment. That’s why this will take ALL of us — not just Congress. We all have a part to play in defending our rights, protecting our communities, and restoring our democracy. So, here are a few things I’m doing OUTSIDE Congress as a candidate, citizen, and organizer: **1\. I’m adopting a swing district!** Starting immediately, we will direct our grassroots energy from Washington’s 6th District to Arizona’s 6th District. The Republican incumbent, Juan Ciscomani, has voted in lockstep with Trump and Musk, even though he won by only 2.5% in 2024 and only 1.5% in 2022. I’m very excited about this new effort — stay tuned for more updates! **2\. I’m hiring a Political Director.** There are limits to what Congressional staff can do politically since they are paid by your tax dollars (yes, we care about ethics!). So, our campaign is hiring a new staffer to work outside the halls of Congress to strengthen our organizing locally and in our adopted swing district. **3\. Derek — Throughout my career in politics, I’ve had one guiding principle: **Love.**
Love is the reason why, as a first-time candidate running for Newark City Council, I went on a hunger strike to draw attention to the desperation facing the most vulnerable communities in our city.
Love motivated me to run for mayor, and after coming up short the first time, love motivated me to get back up and try again.
Love is what has carried me through days when it feels like the forces of chaos and division keep our nation inescapably focused on destructive acts of hate.
There’s no such thing as too much love, Derek. It’s the driving force that keeps folks safe, gives us hope when we have none, and inspires us to create the America we know is possible.
And love is what drives Senate Democrats to fight for affordable housing, to help working Americans keep more of their hard-earned paycheck, to lower the cost of child care and groceries, and so much more.
Derek, Adam and I will work with anyone who wants to make life better for folks like you. But if Donald Trump, Elon Musk, and Senate Republicans do things to hurt you — like coming after affordable health care, pursuing policies that drive up costs, and paying for tax cuts for the wealthy by coming after your hard-earned benefits — **we will fight.**

Jim Himes](https://substack.com/redirect/61c9cb75-535f-4210-afd1-90e4f04b7487?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** for exaggerating the seriousness of the Signal group chat leak in order to win political points on Republicans for the first time in months.
[Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/61c9cb75-535f-4210-afd1-90e4f04b7487?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

Himes scolded Cain and Republicans for, in his view, not taking accountability and apologizing for the Signal group chat leak.
"Stop right there!" Cain interrupted the Democrat's monologue. "We agree it is a mistake! You inserted the word serious," Cain pointed out, claiming that this is the first time in month Democrats have been able to score points on Republicans and now need to make it as big and valuable for their side as possible by using hyperbolic language and exaggerating the seriousness of the leak."
"You even now invoked that men could be killed! **[There's nothing in this to suggest that to be true!"](https://substack.com/redirect/61c9cb75-535f-4210-afd1-90e4f04b7487?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Cain continued.
Himes countered pointing the finger at Cain, Fox News and the Republicans for politicizing the incident, "It makes me want to THROW UP to hear you make this into a partisan issue!!"

### By Jonathan Goldstein
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/9b4bfd41-7868-4df7-b219-e4fc625526a8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[Pledge your support](https://substack..kktUNOh0Pc1oCVg_HeHH9TNvmJdq0TxR2o11eBTxkdE?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=160193713)
###
Chris Murphy spoke at a Town hall at Westhill High School in Stamford on Friday night to a room filled with almost a thousand supporters, and less than a handful of those who disagreed with the Senator and his form of governance.
The event was promoted by Indivisible Stamford, which is part of the Indivisible network that has been popping up at Tesla Takedown protests throughout the country to embolden Democrats who are disgruntled with the November election results.
The Town Hall was a spectacle in the name of DEI, but the majority of the demographic was mostly white senior citizens (with more women than men), a sprinkling of progressive youth and representation from the local democrat party in Stamford and Greenwich.
The two gender neutral bathrooms outside the auditorium provided a source of humor all night long.
I was taken aback reading the gender neutral sign, noting two gendered figures specific to men and women, but missing the combined third icon symbolic of gender fluidity or simply the "all gender" sign without icons, the most inclusive sign.
I walked into a bathroom that contained two urinals--which are gender specific restroom devices--and one stall, which is gender neutral as toilets are universal.
I was more upset that the sign only had the handicap symbol and was missing the braille required underneath to comply with the Americans With Disability Act (ADA). This was truly not an inclusive sign.
As I used one of the urinals, multiple women came in and apologized for disturbing my stream. I simply laughed and attempted to add some levity to the absurdity of this particular bathroom, which contained only one working stall and no door at the entrance to the bathroom. A woman popped out of the stall and apologized as well.
This happened throughout the night, so I was easily able to capture the mass confusion and hysteria associated with women, especially, being concerned, confused or taken aback by sharing a bathroom with those who identify as male.
[](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/57b32c1c-2ad3-43b7-9ccd-ebda0f928850?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The "conservatives" in attendance felt comfortable using the facilities, but the progressives who pushed for this inclusive facility seemed entirely confused and uncomfortable.
We are the same group of conservatives that do not object to females using male restrooms at stadiums when the lines to the women's rooms are too long. To quote from a Bronx Tale, "nobody cares" or at least we don't unless you try to give a male child a tampon with no place to put it.
I have no objections to gender-neutral single-occupancy bathrooms, and many public places have done an amazing job to create communal and private gender-neutral water closets with shared sinks that do not cause hysteria, concern, or result in numerous apologies. WC is gender neutral, with no symbol needed, and it is how it's referred to when a bathroom is filed on building plans.
In those WC locations, there is no feeling of being threatened or triggered or intimidated or insecure by the use of such facilities, especially those who suffer from [paruresis](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/67086524-9dc5-4174-8e4f-6dc29c44e485?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), a type of social anxiety disorder where people find it difficult or impossible to urinate when they are in the presence of others, like in a public restroom. It's often referred to as "shy bladder syndrome" or "bashful bladder". **I don 't think children or adults should leave a restroom and then need a mental health consult for a disorder that can be prevented by common sense or single-occupancy facilities.**
More importantly, there's nothing neutral about a bathroom that contains urinals as the primary waste capturing device--a device that is only for those assigned male at birth.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/9243d155-4603-435d-9da8-c9f59a6b99f4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
_Yale 's $304 sign; Screenshot, Yale Daily News_
While I could not ascertain the price of Westhill's signage, I do know that [Yale University spent $7,000](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/21a3011b-f524-49e8-86e3-076451107fab?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to put "all gender" signs in 23 buildings in 2015, and they probably spent less as a private institution.
If you want to have a gender neutral bathroom, take a lesson from our progressive New York neighbors that originated these policies. They got it right four years ago. For schools, all single-occupancy bathroom facilities must be designated as gender neutral and "for use by no more than one occupant at a time or for family or assisted use."
We can't even copy our neighbors right -- this was not a single-occupancy bathroom.
Had I turned to zip up while a woman walked in, she probably would have screamed and the three police officers would have charged me with Public Indecency, a Class B misdemeanor.
If it was a single-occupancy facility, then we probably wouldn't object to tampons either. Tampons are unnecessary where urinals are present, except when it's one of those single occupancy bathrooms with both a toilet and a urinal to keep men from missing the target and hitting the seat.
What further concerns me is: what if it had been a school assembly instead of Murphy's Town Hall?
And what if I was a male teacher using that urinal and turned to "zip-up" just as a female student walked into the bathroom. It would make the nightly news, and the teacher would likely be fired or suspended, even if his political views were progressive!
The law of unintended consequences has to be revisited here.
_**My progressive friends, pretty please rethink your policies, as you are often the ones most affected by them.**_

In those WC locations, there is no feeling of being threatened or triggered or intimidated or insecure by the use of such facilities, especially those who suffer from , a type of social anxiety disorder where people find it difficult or impossible to urinate when they are in the presence of others, like in a public restroom. It's often referred to as "shy bladder syndrome" or "bashful bladder". I don 't think children or adults should leave a restroom and then need a mental health consult for a disorder that can be prevented by common sense or single-occupancy facilities. More importantly, there's nothing neutral about a bathroom that contains urinals as the primary waste capturing device--a device that is only for those assigned male at birth. | | ---|---|--- Yale 's $304 sign; Screenshot, Yale Daily News While I could not ascertain the price of Westhill's signage, I do know that to put "all gender" signs in 23 buildings in 2015, and they probably spent less as a private institution. If you want to have a gender neutral bathroom, take a lesson from our progressive New York neighbors that originated these policies. They got it right four years ago. For schools, all single-occupancy bathroom facilities must be designated as gender neutral and "for use by no more than one occupant at a time or for family or assisted use." We can't even copy our neighbors right -- this was not a single-occupancy bathroom. Had I turned to zip up while a woman walked in, she probably would have screamed and the three police officers would have charged me with Public Indecency, a Class B misdemeanor. If it was a single-occupancy facility, then we probably wouldn't object to tampons either. Tampons are unnecessary where urinals are present, except when it's one of those single occupancy bathrooms with both a toilet and a urinal to keep men from missing the target and hitting the seat. What further concerns me is: what if it had been a school assembly instead of Murphy's Town Hall? And what if I was a male teacher using that urinal and turned to "zip-up" just as a female student walked into the bathroom. It would make the nightly news, and the teacher would likely be fired or suspended, even if his political views were progressive! The law of unintended consequences has to be revisited here. My progressive friends, pretty please rethink your policies, as you are often the ones most affected by them.** You can follow Jonathan Goldstein on X at. Sunday church takes me back to my childhood. It was the place where I found solace at a time when kids who looked like me were othered and excluded. Whether in schools, stores, or restaurants, everything was separate – nothing was equal.

But church gave me a place to connect with my community, to God, and to my fundamental values. During these trying times we’re facing today, I find the same solace there as I did back then.

Right now, our country is deeply divided. Donald Trump and Elon Musk are shaking the foundations of our democracy and leaving so many Americans behind. And as we try to pick up the pieces and fight back, it’s easy to feel alone.

I’m reaching out because you’re not alone, Peter. When we look to our neighbors, members of our churches, and teachers in our schools, we find that we have more in common than we think.

And before my FEC deadline tonight, I am calling on all of us to come together and show the current administration who we really are. We are Americans who value freedom, democracy, and the rule of law. And we will lock arms and stand up to anyone who tries to undo our progress.

The best way you can support my work in Congress is to make a small donation of $10 or $25. body:
I need you in this fight - are you with me?

| | | | |
---
Friend – the latest poll in **FL-6** just dropped, and I am locked in a dead heat with my radical leftist opponent **inside the******margin of error****.
We are staring down the barrel of a loss that could rip Congress apart and unleash chaos.
The other side smells blood in the water, and they’re pouring in **_millions of dollars_** to buy this race... And if the latest poll is any indication, **their strategy might be working**.

[DEFEND THE MAJORITY](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/afzs/?__vbtrk=MjgyODQ4OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjgyODQ4OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)

****
**Without additional resources I have no way of countering the lies flooding the airwaves.** That's why I’m coming to you asking, whatever you can spare, please chip in a contribution of any amount right now.
This isn’t about politics as usual, it’s about saving the House of Representatives from descending into chaos. Your donation today isn’t just a contribution, it could be the difference between victory and a defeat that could haunt us for years if we fail.

[CLOSE THE GAP](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/afzs/?__vbtrk=MjgyODQ4OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjgyODQ4OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
Please stand with me to _**protect Congress**_ , to _**protect our country**_ , to **_protect everything that’s been built since we put President Trump back in the White House_.**

**__[We’ve come too far to lose now, let’s fight like hell and take this race across the finish line](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/afzs/?__vbtrk=MjgyODQ4OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjgyODQ4OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)_._**

_Yours,_

**Randy Fine** Candidate for Congress

It’s Jamie, Sarah’s Chief of Staff. Sarah and Team Elfreth are now a few months into the job in Congress so I wanted to let you know what we’ve been working on.
Earlier this month, Sarah introduced her first bill: the bipartisan Protect our Probationary Employees Act will ensure that federal employees who are reinstated don’t have to restart their probationary clocks. We were joined by a number of constituents at a press conference who were passionate, hard working probationary employees affected by the Trump administration’s reckless firings.
Later that night, we held our first in-person town hall with Senators Angela Alsobrooks and Chris Van Hollen, and Howard County Executive Calvin Ball. Our team was energized by the over 1,000 constituents who turned out!
We kept that momentum going with a Medicaid roundtable, where Sarah convened State and local leaders in the Medicaid space to discuss how critical it is that we protect Medicaid in this moment. We’ve got more events and town halls—both virtually and in person—planned in the coming weeks where we will continue to listen and provide support for our constituents.
All the while, our team is answering hundreds of calls every week, helping constituents with casework issues, and continuing to fight on behalf of all Marylanders against the destructive actions of the Trump Administration.
I couldn’t be more proud of the progress we’ve made, but I’m wondering: will you chip in to support this all-star team? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/blu-sefc-q2-2025-em?refcode=blu_em_sefc_2025-03-29]

| All last year Michael Baumgartner promised to put Eastern Washington above party politics. Instead, he’s caved to Elon Musk’s DOGE, hopped into the pocket of extremist national Republican leadership, and abandoned our values.

Want an example? He remained silent as DOGE canceled millions in funding for agricultural research at WSU and broke contracts to reimburse farming families for clean energy investments. **WA-05 deserves better.** That’s why I’m running again – to fight for the hardworking people of Eastern Washington. You’ve been one of my strongest supporters from the beginning , Peter, so I’m counting on you once again to help us hit the ground running.

[**Will you chip in now to become a founding donor of my 2026 campaign? CFPM: Florida holds special primary election to fill vacancies in U.S. House
You can tell that we're making progress in Florida, Team, because the MAGA crew just pulled back Congresswoman Elise Stefanik's nomination to be the U.S. Ambassador to the U.N. -- worried that it might cost them the house.
As a reminder: Florida is holding a special election on Tuesday to fill vacancies in the U.S. House of Representatives, following cabinet nominations by President Donald Trump. And they're worried about opponents of voting rights losing elections in districts Trump won by 30 points last fall.
What else makes these special elections important? Opponents of voting rights hold a 3 seat majority -- 218 to 215 -- in the House. One media report after another tells the tale -- Speaker Mike Johnson is having a hard time wrangling them all to vote for his priorities, and any dent made in that majority will make it harder for them to pass bills that harm voting rights this year or next.
It all starts with the American Confidence in Elections (ACE) Act which would nationalize voter suppression and the Safeguard American Voter Eligibility (SAVE) Act, which would add onerous voter ID requirements, potentially disenfranchising millions of married women who changed their last names. Those bills are just the tip of the suppressive iceberg, with many in Congress looking to follow the election lies to policies that disenfranchise voters and make Trump happy.
We can stop all that with huge voter turnout in these Florida specials. But we need your help to make sure every voter in Florida is aware of these special elections, when early voting starts, how to request a new mail-in ballot, and so much more.

And they're worried about opponents of voting rights losing elections in districts Trump won by 30 points last fall. What else makes these special elections important? Opponents of voting rights hold a 3 seat majority -- 218 to 215 -- in the House. One media report after another tells the tale -- Speaker Mike Johnson is having a hard time wrangling them all to vote for his priorities, and any dent made in that majority will make it harder for them to pass bills that harm voting rights this year or next. It all starts with the American Confidence in Elections (ACE) Act which would nationalize voter suppression and the Safeguard American Voter Eligibility (SAVE) Act, which would add onerous voter ID requirements, potentially disenfranchising millions of married women who changed their last names. Those bills are just the tip of the suppressive iceberg, with many in Congress looking to follow the election lies to policies that disenfranchise voters and make Trump happy. We can stop all that with huge voter turnout in these Florida specials. But we need your help to make sure every voter in Florida is aware of these special elections, when early voting starts, how to request a new mail-in ballot, and so much more. Dear Fellow American,

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future.

A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.

That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a National Survey on Presidential Selection.

By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders.

You can complete the National Survey on Presidential Selection by using the link below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=17x64w94u6dkmgips0yemhj2uue8718ox1jyw1vip428w9zppb3fidass109t2spvb7v9gx0svgamayyolldtlhddub0gdt5gfuxgkkzgk0bgd7cr0rt88ln539hsx5l26eowlk1f7lq44w5c8pqhf4wqid59m&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sty8qh&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sty8qh&__onlt=t

Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?

YES
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sty8qh&__onlt=t

NO
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sty8qh&__onlt=t

For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government.

But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.

This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states.

These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over six million households and businesses nationwide with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;

Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College.

And this is especially important in this critical time for America's future.

So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.

You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=17x64w94u6dkmgips0yemhj2uue8718oxqnuspvvxirzp6cfqc0ulz3c9xjwldohu23wen5v1c3ivynxta5i726vcoyg35m9hp0d2fectwg7lhipbbj360v3dqtzpr78r523x8f073cgjf4v9f0p5f41ibuef3&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sty8qh&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sty8qh&__onlt=t

And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work.

Please represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential Selection today. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

President, Hillsdale College

Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Yesterday I held a town hall in Orange County for the people that Republican Young Kim has been hiding from. After speaking with them for nearly two hours and answering their questions I can see why she’s afraid to face them.
People are furious with her and House Republicans for bowing down to Donald Trump and Elon Musk and selling out the American People in the process. They are allowing the destruction of Social Security, Medicaid, the Department of Education, Foreign Aid, and so much more. And even worse, they are doing all this while refusing to look their constituents in the eyes and answer their questions.
[Can you help me hold more of these events by chipping in to help cover our travel expenses?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/104825034/536569471/2133160978?refcode2=4dd49d4a-980d-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&refcode=em250330&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ZGQ0OWQ0YS05ODBkLWYwMTEtOTBjZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Sd_bZfzW55tSDXZCuOfMYtDjZWYqTscQgh42AZZrrq8=)

The American People deserve better than what Republicans are giving them right now. While they are working hard day in and day out to make ends meet for their families, Republicans are selling them out to give more tax breaks to billionaires like Elon Musk. Hopefully the town hall we just did will be a wake up call for Young Kim and we will see her grow a spine and start to oppose some of the insane damage Trump and Musk are causing. But I won’t hold my breath.
Next up on our Republican Town Hall Tour, I will be heading to Ken Calvert’s district in the Palm Desert area. I’m currently working on details for this event and will be sure to keep you posted once it’s finalized. But for now I’m hoping you can help.
[These events require a ton of resources to put together. Between the venue, staff, travel, and other items, the price tag for these events adds up quickly. [DONATE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/104825036/536569473/2133160978?refcode2=4dd49d4a-980d-f011-90cd-0022482a9fb7&refcode=em250330&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ZGQ0OWQ0YS05ODBkLWYwMTEtOTBjZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Sd_bZfzW55tSDXZCuOfMYtDjZWYqTscQgh42AZZrrq8=)

I am going to continue holding these town halls because they are important. The most basic duty of elected officials is to hear from, and respond to, those you represent. And if Republicans won’t do it, I will. And I am so thankful to have your support as we make sure the American people are heard.

Robert

name: Kristen McDonald Rivet
subject: Here’s how we won (and how we can do it again)
body:
|
#

| _<**We've left last week's information on Issue 2 below just in case you missed it!** >_

**This issue is beatable!**
1) Turnout for the **May 6th PRIMARY ELECTION** is expected to be around 5% of registered Ohio voters. That's about 400,000 total votes.
2) The past 2 times a similar bond issue was on the ballot, the winning margin was 19.23%, let's round that up to 20%. That means 60% YES & 40% NO. Or, 240,000 YES votes & 160,000 NO votes. A 20% difference or 80,000 vote differential.
3) **FIRST** , if we can educate 10% of the potential YES voters & turn them to NO voters, the result would be 216,000 YES votes & 184,000 NO votes, a 24,000 vote swing. Across Ohio's 88 counties we'd need to persuade 273 YES voters to vote NO, **A VERY REASONABLE** thing to do.
4) **SECOND** , if we can activate 40,000 voters who typically don't vote in primary elections **and get them to vote** , that's a turnout increase of only 0.5%, or one-half of one percent! This is also **A VERY REASONABLE** thing for us to try to get done! It's only an additional 455 votes per county.
5) **WHEN** we do this, **WE WIN!** The final vote count would be 224,000 NO and 216,000 YES = 440,000 total votes = 5.5% turnout. Again, **A****VERY REASONABLE** objective!
**WHAT EACH OF US CAN DO TO SPREAD THE WORD AND MAKE THIS HAPPEN!**
Over the next week, **PLEASE** :
* Make 10 **social media posts** on the issue

name: Mark Kelly
subject: Social Security, Medicaid, and the VA
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
body:
If you’re reading these emails, chances are you’re paying a lot more attention to this stuff than your friends and family are. You’re probably really fired up, too. That’s a good thing — more people should be as fired up as you are.
#

Friend —
I think most of you know that Elon Musk, his slash-and-burn campaign, and the Trump White House are trying to force through more than a trillion dollars in tax breaks for the richest people and most profitable corporations in the country.
And if you know that, you likely also know that they’re making room for those tax breaks by cutting the programs and services that you, your loved ones, or your friends depend on. Deleting the Department of Education, for one. Hundreds of billions cut from Medicaid. Closed offices, slashed staff, and reduced funding at Social Security. Thousands fired at the VA, impacting lifesaving programs.
Now, I’ve got to touch base with you on this, because it’s important. If you’re reading these emails, chances are you’re paying a lot more attention to this stuff than your friends and family are. You’re probably really fired up, too. That’s a good thing — more people should be as fired up as you are.
But the truth is, this is a special group. And the harder truth is, a lot of people haven’t heard what Trump and Elon are doing. They’re busy with their own lives, raising their kids, trying to get bills paid. That’s not a criticism, and I mean that. It’s hard enough just getting by. But if we’re going to stop Elon and Trump from carrying out the worst that they’re trying to do, we’ve got to get those folks on board.
That’s what I’m trying to do right now. The work I’m doing, my social media, interviews I do in the news, my conversations with people in Arizona, the travel we’ll be doing to support the next generation of democratic candidates — we’re trying to get this stuff to break through.
Believe it or not, none of that comes easy, or cheap. It’s a lot of work, and it might surprise you to learn that we’re not a very big team. So, the donations we get from emails like this are a big help — they’re the primary way we cover the cost of the work we’re doing.
They mean a lot to me. Really. It’s humbling to have the support of people like you. But it also means that I have to ask, from time to time. And today is one of those days.
[**So, respectfully: Can you chip in $3 to help us keep up the fight?**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-mar25.qCIGIs&refcode=em250330-1-500&t=1&akid=6029%2E6688874%2E99KoIC)

name: Doug Lindner, LCV
subject: Re: [ACT TODAY]: Help protect democracy against threats to voting rights and election integrity
body:
To view this mail in a browser, copy https://links.messages.lcv.org/servlet/MailView?ms=MTIzMTc1MDIS1&r=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&j=MjE4MDQzOTM3NgS2&mt=1&rt=0 into your browser.
We have an update for you, Peter, The SAVE Act, a bill that would disenfranchise millions of eligible voters by
requiring hugely restrictive voter ID requirements, is expected to come up for a
vote in the House this week. If enacted, even a driver’s license wouldn’t be
enough to vote. The bill would also effectively ban voter registration drives,
online voter registration, and voter registration by mail. Congress needs to hear from us before the vote, Peter. Tell them now: Vote NO on the extreme anti-voter SAVE Act, and demand that Congress protect our right to vote in free and fair elections >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/k_ Only just last week, President Trump attempted to illegally strip voting rights
from many millions of eligible voters by executive order. This authoritarian
power grab seeks to gut registration methods that have long made voting safer,
more accessible, and more equitable. We can’t let any of these attacks on our democracy move forward. Make sure your voice is heard. Thanks for being with us. LCV Rapid Response
Alex, Annie, Shae, Kelly, and Chris TELL CONGRESS TO PROTECT VOTING RIGHTS AND ELECTION INTEGRITY

A bill that is moving rapidly through Congress, the SAVE Act, is threatening to
undermine the integrity of our nation’s democracy. This bill disenfranchises
millions of eligible voters by imposing draconian barriers to voter
registration.

The House could vote on this bill within the next few days — and we have a real
chance to prevent it from becoming law. But we need your help: Send a message to your members of Congress today urging them to vote NO on the SAVE Act. Help us reach our 5,000 signature goal >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/ambdF6~qW_ TAKE ACTION NOW >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/RZbkcR~ Hi Peter, The Republican-led Congress is wasting no time in working to undermine our
democracy. A bill called the SAVE Act is rapidly moving towards a vote on the
floors of the House and Senate, and it is a major attack on voting rights,
election integrity, and trust in our voting system. The SAVE Act would disenfranchise millions of eligible votersby requiring hugely restrictive voter ID requirements, which disproportionately
impact marginalized communities, including seniors, students, people of color,
and women. It would effectively ban voter registration drives, online voter
registration, and voter registration by mail. By requiring registering voters to register in person and show documents proving
their citizenship, this bill would make registration harder for the more than
146 million estimated Americans who don’t have a valid U.S. passport, the 69
million estimated married women whose current names don’t match their birth
certificate names, and the millions of people from the LGBTQ+ community whose
name or genders don’t match up with what’s on their passports or birth
certificates. The SAVE Act is a voter suppression bill that only pretends to address a real
problem. States already have secure systems in place to verify eligibility and
prevent noncitizens from voting. There are already state and federal laws
imposing severe penalties for voting by people who aren’t eligible. There is no
widespread voter fraud in America, but anti-democracy politicians want to make
voting harder anyway. Our movement can stop them — but we need your voice to speak out against this harmful federal legislation
that threatens voting rights and election integrity. Tell your members of Congress: Vote NO on the extreme anti-voter SAVE Act. Help LCV reach 5,000 signatures demanding that Congress protect our right to vote in free and fair elections >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/w_ywTKk_ TAKE ACTION >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/~ The right to vote is the foundation of our democracy and our nation’s most
cherished freedom. It is foundational to protecting clean air and clean water,
fighting for a sustainable future, securing environmental justice, protecting
public lands, and curbing health-harming pollution. There can be no healthy environment without a healthy democracy.This legislation weakens the political power of everyday people and could block
progress on the critical issues that affect our communities and our planet by
making it harder for millions of Americans to vote. You can help stop these harmful measures. Take action today: It only takes a moment to tell Congress to protect our voting rights >> https://links.messages.lcv. Thank you for your commitment to protecting our democracy! Onward, Doug Lindner
Senior Director of Judiciary & Democracy
League of Conservation Voters This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. If this isn't the best email address at which to reach you,update your contact information https://www.pages08.net/leagueofconservationvoters/forms/ContactInformation?spMailingID=12317502&spUserID=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&spJobID=MjE4MDQzOTM3NgS2&spReportId=MjE4MDQzOTM3NgS2.Click here to unsubscribe https://www.pages08.net/leagueofconservationvoters/forms/Unsubscribe?spMailingID=12317502&spUserID=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&spJobID=MjE4MDQzOTM3NgS2&spReportId=MjE4MDQzOTM3NgS2 from our supporter list.Send us any comments, criticisms, or feedback here mailto:feedback@lcv.org?subject=, or just reply to this email! Thanks for your support.

740 15th St NW, Suite 700
Washington, DC 20005
202-785-8683 DONATE https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/NvbyBG~

Hi Peter, my
friend and colleague Senator Cory Booker asked if he could reach out. If
you have a moment, please read his message below, and consider
[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=stb-em-booker25.NHpduE&refcode=AU_STB_FR_TAN_EOQ_AC_20250330_PM1_V1_S1&t=1004&akid=4635%2E35263%2E35ihQX ]splitting a donation between his campaign and mine before our
end-of-quarter deadline. Thanks!

— Tammy

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Peter —
throughout my career in politics, I’ve had one guiding principle: Love.

Love is the reason why, as a first-time candidate running for Newark City
Council, I went on a hunger strike to draw attention to the desperation
facing the most vulnerable communities in our city.

Love motivated me to run for mayor, and after coming up short the first
time, love motivated me to get back up and try again.

Love is what has carried me through days when it feels like the forces of
chaos and division keep our nation inescapably focused on destructive acts
of hate.

There’s no such thing as too much love,
Peter. It’s the driving force
that keeps folks safe, gives us hope when we have none, and inspires us to
create the America we know is possible.

And love is what drives Senate Democrats to fight for affordable housing,
to help working Americans keep more of their hard-earned paycheck, to
lower the cost of child care and groceries, and so much more.

Peter, Tammy
Baldwin and I will work with anyone who wants to make life better for
folks like you. But if Donald Trump, Elon Musk, and Senate Republicans do
things to hurt you — like coming after affordable health care, pursuing
policies that drive up costs, and paying for tax cuts for the wealthy by
coming after your hard-earned benefits — we will fight.

If you have a moment, please read his message below, and consider [ ]splitting a donation between his campaign and mine before our end-of-quarter deadline. Love is the reason why, as a first-time candidate running for Newark City Council, I went on a hunger strike to draw attention to the desperation facing the most vulnerable communities in our city. Love motivated me to run for mayor, and after coming up short the first time, love motivated me to get back up and try again. Love is what has carried me through days when it feels like the forces of chaos and division keep our nation inescapably focused on destructive acts of hate. There’s no such thing as too much love, Peter. It’s the driving force that keeps folks safe, gives us hope when we have none, and inspires us to create the America we know is possible. Peter, the work of democracy has always been hard. It's always been contentious. For every two steps forward, it often feels like we take one step back. But the long story of America has been defined by a forward motion — a constant widening of our founding creed to embrace all and not just some. Peter, I know that these days — in times of great challenge and uncertainty — it’s easy to get discouraged or feel cynical about what’s possible. **It takes resolve and dedication to remember who we aspire to be. ** For nearly 250 years, our nation's call to citizenship has given work and purpose to each new generation. It's what led patriots to choose republic over tyranny, pioneers to trek west, enslaved folks to brave that makeshift railroad to freedom. It's what pushed women to fight for the right to vote at the ballot box. It's why GIs gave their lives at Omaha Beach and Iwo Jima — and why men and women from Selma to Stonewall were prepared to give theirs, as well. **Citizenship is calling each of us. It's our turn to rise to the moment, to stay true to our values, and to lock arms with those around us who are also intent on moving this country forward.** **I’m proud to support the NDRC to do this hard, but necessary work of advancing our democracy by fighting for fair representation across our country.** As the strategic hub for our work to end gerrymandering, they help make it possible for voters to pick their politicians instead of the other way around — and they count on grassroots support like yours to power this work. body:
Standing up for people is always right.
Peter,

Bullying is wrong — full stop. Standing up for people is always right.

Here in Kentucky, Andy’s faith guides him to treat people with kindness and respect. It’s why he’s never comfortable when politicians use their power to tear others down — _especially the very people they were elected to serve._

Good leaders don’t govern through cruelty. They don’t mock their constituents or use them as political props. Good leaders lift people up. They fight for them. They serve them. That’s what Andy believes in, and it’s what he fights for every single day.

**This isn’t an either-or choice.**

As Democrats, we don’t just stand for what’s right — we act on it. We fight for the values that matter: Dignity, opportunity, and fairness for every family. body:

| |
Peter,

As we reach the end of March, my campaign is up against our first big fundraising deadline and I'm reaching out today to ask for your help.

Campaigns are required to file a report of the total amount our campaign has raised as of March 31, 2025.

For better or worse, this disclosure will be used to measure the strength of our campaign. As the only Republican candidate for Lieutenant Governor that's qualified for the ballot so far, press and pundits will be looking to see if we have what it takes to defeat the Democrats this year.

We know we've got what it takes, but it's critical that we show that strength on this first public filing.

I'm asking for your help today to make that happen. [Will you consider making a contribution - whether $25, $250, or whatever you are able to give - to help us publish the strongest possible fundraising number and signal that we are in it to win this year?](https://patherrity.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=deffacbf7c4eb8be8b9889258&id=1ab2570663&e=a1ea0f9c99)

I know it's early in the year, but I'm laser-focused on November because the stakes this year are high. If we allow liberal Democrats to control our statewide offices and General Assembly, the damage to Virginia will be catastrophic.

I'm tremendously grateful for your support as we approach this first significant deadline, and I look forward to working with you to ensure that Virginia continues to be guided by our commonsense, conservative ideals!

subject: A free eBook on the most historic events in American history
body:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=styly0&__onlt=t

Dear Fellow American,

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future.

A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.

That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a National Survey on Presidential Selection.

By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders.

You can complete the National Survey on Presidential Selection by using the link below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=17x64w94u6dknplfdokvlis3hcnap0khx171bc4y08q8bnhgo4syhklig3gz8sepmdgxncsgxqggnsi6u3aov5nomiwh64z9o9fs9feno98u85zq6wdxfe7g99x146kaup65k4eoksriqtl8wxwqmgaaf86qx0&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=styly0&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=styly0&__onlt=t

Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?

YES
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=styly0&__onlt=t

NO
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=styly0&__onlt=t

For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government.

But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.

This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states.

These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over six million households and businesses nationwide with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;

Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College.

And this is especially important in this critical time for America's future.

So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.

You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=17x64w94u6dknplfdokvlis3hcnap0khx1sae6opk365idx0bdyltfg7w1wghykidm14rrjs0scdpeibjkd0pszs0dq0m09hy0up2eb9z95930ti7741hmudksyk7fxa4yh38296u0e63gdb7xrs0w6piv431s&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=styly0&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=styly0&__onlt=t

And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work.

Please represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential Selection today. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

President, Hillsdale College

Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

It’s not hard to see why. We suspect our inbox is just as crowded as yours with candidates seeking to raise the resources they need to win their campaigns. But while some campaigns can go running to wealthy mega-donors to meet their goals, **we rely on grassroots power, where supporters chip in what they can, when they can. ** And truthfully, we really don’t want to bother Tina with bad news on fundraising. She’s busy making progress for the people of Oregon — the last thing she needs to think about is missing a fundraising goal. Trust us, we get it.
